entities.d: Not very pretty, but useful when it comes to creating protection from the elements.
entities.ob:
There are three ways to obtain Tar: Crafting, a burnt out Campfire or burning Food.
A burnt out campfire will yield 1 Tar per 2 Wood required to craft the Campfire, whilst crafting will yield 1 Tar per 1.2 Wood + 0.3 Dirt.
Burning food will yield 1 Tar.
entities.intro: Tar is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: The liquified essence of the Shroud, harvested from enshrouded growths of the Springlands biome.
entities.ob: Shroud Liquid can be found in the Shroud, looted from mushrooms on the ground and gathered using tools from larger mushrooms.
entities.intro: Shroud Liquid is a crafting material in Enshrouded

entities.d: An organic bag containing highly concentrated Shroud spores.
This protective juice of trees has many functions. First and foremost, serving the cause of the trees!
entities.ob:
Resin can be obtained through chopping down trees.
It can be more quickly obtained by chopping trees with red leaves and grown Revelwood Red Leaf Seedlings.
fr:Résine
entities.intro: Resin is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: The wood of Shroud infested trees. Its structure and properties are changed forever.
entities.ob: Shroud Wood can be gathered in the Shroud by chopping down trees found there.
entities.intro: Shroud Wood is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Warm and comfortable during yearfall. A versatile resource that is very common and can be used for many things.
entities.ob:
Animal Fur is crafted by the Hunter. The crafting recipe requires obtaining Fur Patch to unlock.
Animal Fur is also a common drop from wildlife and Vukah. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world.
entities.intro: Animal Fur is a Springlands Crafting Material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Restores 60% of health over 10 seconds. Stops when damage is received.
entities.ob: They can be crafted or found as a drop.
entities.intro: Cleaned Bandages are a consumable that heal for +6% Healing Per Second.

entities.d: A rake made of the simplest materials. A basic tool used to flatten the ground for upcoming construction works.
entities.ob: Rake is crafted at the Workbench. The crafting recipe requires either reaching level 5 or obtaining Pickaxe to unlock.

entities.d: Maybe they can be used as strings? They seem to be pretty robust.
entities.ob:
Plant Fiber is gathered from bushes found throughout Embervale. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world.
Bushes can also be grown from Shrub Seedlings.
fr:Fibre de plante
entities.intro: Plant Fiber is a Crafting Material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Created in a kiln under high temperatures. Burned wood mixed with oxygen creates a flammable material, highly convenient and needed to dive into the world of craftsmanship.
entities.intro: Charcoal is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: This byproduct of the Charcoal Kiln has many useful properties, which can be used in medicine and alchemy.
entities.ob:
You'll unlock the Wood Acid recipe once you craft Charcoal for the first time.
Crafted in a Charcoal Kiln, this recipe produce 10 Wood Acids in 7 minutes.
entities.intro: Wood Acid is a crafting material in Enshrouded

entities.d: A tool to create various coal related items from wood.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining Stone for the first time. It is then crafted at the Blacksmith.
entities.intro: Charcoal Kiln is a crafting station in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Place this Flame Altar above the Shroud to mark your home. Build inside the marked area around the Flame Altar.
entities.intro: The Flame Altar marks the spot for a base. Any changes made within the boundaries of the Flame Altar are permanent, unless the Altar is extinguished. Changes made outside the Altar’s boundaries, however, will reset after 30 minutes or upon a game restart.

entities.d: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
entities.ob: Crude Mattress is crafted at the Workbench. The crafting recipe requires retrieving the Blacksmith during Find The Sleeping Survivor to unlock.
entities.intro: Crude Mattress is a Bed. It very slightly increases Comfort in your base.

entities.d: Over the years, untouched by anyone, the bones of all kind of magical creatures have hardened and turned to stone. A rare material due to its limited availibility and high magical capacity.
entities.ob:
Mined from giant bones found in the Nomad Highlands and the Kindlewastes.
An easily accessible giant fossilized rib cage is located west of the .

entities.d: Remains of metal, which was present to witness humanity's downfall. They might turn out to be useful.
entities.ob:
Metal Scraps are common drops from Scavengers. It can also be looted from destroyed metal objects or picked up as a physical item in the world.
The Scavengers around are a good source in the early game.
fr:Ferraille
entities.intro: Metal Scraps are a Springlands Crafting Material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A small amount of essence from the Flame! By feeding it back to the Flame Altar maybe it could become stronger and burn even brighter.
entities.ob:
Sparks can be collected from Flame Shrines and Flame Sanctums found throughout Embervale.
The amount of sparks gathered is decided by the biome the Flame Shrine and Sanctum reside.
• Springlands x1
• Revelwood x2
• Nomad Highlands x3
• Kindlewastes x4
• Albaneve Summits x5
• Veilwater Basin x6
entities.intro: Spark is an item in Enshrouded. These sparks of flame are used to upgrade the Flame Altar and unlock Night Sanctums.

entities.d: A stable form of energy. Burning it at the Flame Altar may protect against the Shroud.
entities.ob:
Dropped by Fell bosses, commonly found guarding Shroud Roots and Elixir Wells.
Can also be crafted by the Alchemist.
entities.intro: Shroud Core is a crafting material in Enshrouded

entities.d: A versatile and durable material that is smooth to the touch. It also has the advantage of being waterproof.
entities.intro: Leather is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: This workplace will enable the Hunter to mass produce leather.
entities.ob:
The Tanning Station is obtained in in the Nomad Highlands at the end of In Need Of A Tanning Station for the Hunter.
Additional stations can be crafted at the Hunter after the quest.
entities.intro: Tanning Station is a crafting station in Enshrouded, used to tan Dried Fur into Leather.

entities.d: The natural fiber won from the processing of Flax. The first step of cloth creation.
entities.ob:
Linen is crafted at either the Hand Spindle, the Spinning Wheel, or the Spinning Machine.
The Hand Spindle produces 6 Linen per minute, making it the fastest but most Flax-intensive. The Spinning Wheel is the slowest at 2 Linen per minute, but uses half as much Flax per Linen as the Hand Spindle. The Spinning Machine balances speed and efficiency, averaging 3.75 Linen per minute and using 50% less Flax per Linen than the Spinning Wheel, though it produces in batches.
entities.intro: Linen is a Crafting Material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Mint Mushroom Meat that can be used to dye all sorts of fabrics green. The name suggests a minty fresh taste, but consumption is strongly discouraged.
entities.ob: Mint Mushroom Meat is obtained from chopping down mushroom stalks in the Nomad Highlands Shroud. Just like trees, larger stalks will drop more mushrooms.
entities.intro: Mint Mushroom Meat is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Craft blocks, new items and repair broken equipment.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked by reaching the Return Beacon past the caves after exiting the Cinder Vault for the first time. It is then crafted by Manual Crafting.
entities.intro: The Workbench is the first crafting table the player can craft, using Manual Crafting under the Essentials category.

entities.d: Used to bind things together, String is an extremely important item.
entities.ob:
String is crafted by Manual Crafting, by the Spinning Wheel, or by the Spinning Machine. The crafting recipe requires obtaining Plant Fiber to unlock.
String is also a common drop from Spiders. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world.
entities.intro: String is a Springlands Crafting Material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: This item heals 40% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound. Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.
entities.intro: Bandages are a consumable that heal for +4% Healing Per Second.

facts.Quote: A complex oven used by scholars of the alchemical mysteries.

entities.d: A complex oven used by scholars of the alchemical mysteries.
entities.ob: The Athanor can be crafted at the Alchemist when Scientific Instruments are obtained during the quest Scientific Instruments for a Laboratory.

entities.d: Nobody really knows what it is. They just call it the "Spice". It makes food much more delicious though, so it is highly sought after!
entities.intro: Spice is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Its uses are unknown even to the creator itself, but it definitely didn't help the skin of the Fell!
entities.intro: images= Enshrouded Oil.png

entities.d: Ground up coals, creating a highly flammable powder.
entities.intro: Coal Powder is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A clear liquid with a sharp smell. Used to enhance alchemical reactions.
entities.intro: images= Alchemical Base.png

entities.d: This gland contains a concentrated substance which can be used to tan furs.
entities.ob:
Ammonia Glands are dropped by Fell Mushroom Crabs in the Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes Shroud (notably Umber Hollow).
fr:Glande d'ammoniac
entities.intro: Ammonia Glands are a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Remains of the pests that dwell below the Shroud.
entities.ob:
Critter Parts is a common drop from the Fell Critters found in the Springlands and Revelwood Shroud.
fr:Morceaux de bestioles
entities.intro: Critter Parts is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Runes are mystical artifacts that attract and store magical energy from the environment.
entities.ob: Runes can be obtained from defeating Fell enemies, looting chests, or dismantling weapons.

facts.Quote: A fine mortar. This should enable an Alchemist to broaden their crafting spectrum when placed within their reach.

entities.d: A fine mortar. This should enable an Alchemist to broaden their crafting spectrum when placed within their reach.
entities.ob: The Mortar is obtained from the Alchemist's Tower in , Revelwood, as part of The Alchemist's Mortar for the Alchemist.

entities.d: Requires less stamina. Can be activated at larger ranges.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked during the Alchemist quest The Alchemist's Rumors. It is then crafted at the Carpenter to complete the quest.
entities.intro: title= Improved Grappling Hook

entities.d: A weird brew emitting a blue glow...Nobody quite knows why.
entities.ob:
The recipe is unlocked after crafting spice in the laboratory after obtaining the almanac of Plants and Seedlings.

Crafting requires the primary crafter or workshop and all listed props.

entities.d: A basic setup for preparing meals
entities.ob: Cooking Station is crafted by the Farmer. The crafting recipe requires accepting Cooking Equipment For The Farmer to unlock.
entities.intro: The Cooking Station is a crafting station that automates cooking foods that would ordinarily be cooked at the Fireplace by hand, one at a time.

entities.d: Nails made from Metal Scraps. Sharp objects that can be used as a tool or to improve a weapon.
entities.ob: Nails can be obtained by collecting loot or by crafting at the Blacksmith.
entities.intro: Nails are a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A medical solution to prevent wound infections. Among other things, it can be used to disinfect bandages.
entities.intro: Antiseptic is a consumable in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Created through years of petrification, it has become a beautiful material used for production.
entities.ob:
Mined from red amber veins in the Revelwood Shroud.
Several deposits of amber can be found in the deep shroud cavity between Abandoned Hunter Camp and Hidden Hollow Tomb, north of Revelwood Ancient Spire.
fr:Ambre
entities.intro: Amber is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining a Crucible as part of Crucible Needed For A Smelter. It is then crafted by the Blacksmith if the Forge have been placed.
entities.intro: Ghostly Shield is a Ward, a magical shield with resistances to different types of elements.

entities.d: A crude industrial oven for sintering and heating.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving the Carpenter during Carpentry Assistance. It is then crafted at the Carpenter.
entities.intro: The Kiln is a Carpenter crafting station for firing bricks and clay. It is used to craft bricks, clay, and ceramic objects.

entities.d: An important workplace for a Carpenter which will enable many new crafting opportunities.
entities.ob:
Crafting the Table Saw completes Table Saw For The Carpenter, after obtaining the Circular Sawblades during the quest.
Additional saws can be crafted at the Carpenter after completing the quest, though the ingredients needed to craft more Circular Sawblades are not available until reaching the Kindlewastes.
entities.intro: Table Saw is a crafting station in Enshrouded, used to cut Wood Logs into Wood Planks.

facts.Perks: Magic Fire Damage, Precise, Magic Fire Damage, Mana Leech, Magic Fire Damage

entities.d: This wand practically vibrates with warmth and destructive energy. It becomes restless and twitchy when dormant for too long. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
entities.ob: It can also be obtained through Fishing using Fire Fly.
entities.intro: description = This wand practically vibrates with warmth and destructive energy. It becomes restless and twitchy when dormant for too long.

entities.intro: description= This wand hides a rare frozen core inside, enabling its owner to unleash massive ice damage against foes.

entities.ob: It can also be obtained through Fishing using Fire Fly.

entities.d: This staff was made from the roots of an age-old tree. Wisdom and calm flow through it. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.
entities.ob: It can also be obtained through Fishing using Fire Fly.
entities.intro: description= This staff was made from the roots of an age-old tree. Wisdom and calm flow through it.

entities.d: Even a simple shield such as this can save your life when you get surrounded, or surprised.
entities.intro: title= Rising Fighter Shield

facts.Perks: Cutting Damage, Precise, Brutal, Precise, Brutal

entities.d: An axe of gruesome origin. It has seen many heads roll and still fulfills its purpose today.
entities.intro: description= An axe of gruesome origin. It has seen many heads roll and still fulfills its purpose today.

facts.Perks: Blunt Damage, Health Leech, Blunt Damage, Health Leech, Blunt Damage

entities.d: A frightening mace that brings misfortune to any that oppose it.
entities.ob: It can also be obtained through Fishing using Fire Fly.
entities.intro: description= A frightening mace that brings misfortune to any that oppose it.

facts.Perks: Poison Damage, Vicious, Reaping, Health Leech, Poison Damage

entities.d: A finely handcrafted bow, used by seasoned woodland hunters.
entities.intro: description= A finely handcrafted bow, used by seasoned woodland hunters.

entities.d: An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown. The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.
entities.intro: description= An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

entities.d: A sturdy tool that can help to cross many chasms along the way.
entities.ob:
The recipe is unlocked by obtaining Shroud Spores (looted from defeated Fell enemies) for the first time. It is then crafted at the Workbench.
Crafting a Grappling Hook is the objective of the Blacksmith quest Grappling Hook.
entities.intro: A Grappling Hook is an equipable item that can be used to swing across chasms or reach elevated locations when equipped in the Grappling Hook slot of the Character screen.

entities.d: A strange kind of energy. It appears unstable for now, but perhaps it can be refined.
entities.ob: Shroud Spores are found by looting weaker Shroud creatures.

facts.Perks: Magic Shroud Damage, Mana Leech, Magic Shroud Damage, Mana Currents, Magic Shroud Damage

entities.d: A perplexing wand, corrupted by the Shroud. It bends the mind of its bearer. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
entities.intro: description = A perplexing wand, corrupted by the Shroud. It bends the mind of its bearer.

facts.Perks: Blunt Damage, Merciless, Blunt Damage, Merciless, Blunt Damage

entities.d: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.
entities.ob: Wolf's Hydra is a unique Club (weapon) in Enshrouded. It can be found at .
entities.intro: description= A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.

facts.Perks: Magic Fire Damage, Mana Leech, Magic Fire Damage, Mana Currents, Magic Fire Damage

entities.d: Marked through hundreds of hours of enduring the force of fire, this wand has a connection to the element and is able to utilize it. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
entities.intro: description = Marked through hundreds of hours of enduring the force of fire, this wand has a connection to the element and is able to utilize it.

entities.d: Even in death, the queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield.
entities.intro: Pikemead's Bulwark is a Shield previously owned by Queen Pikemead.

entities.d: The byproducts of felling a tree. Just be careful that it doesn't fall on your head!
entities.ob:
Wood Logs are obtained from chopping down Trees, and destroying wooden objects. The amount obtained is determined by the tree's size, larger trees produce more logs. Along with the logs you can obtain Twigs and Resin.
Better Axes chop trees faster, along with the Mother's Eye to increase chopping strength.
 images= Wood Logs.png
Wood Logs are used in a multitude of crafting recipes. The following items require Wood Logs.
fr:Bûches
entities.intro: Wood Logs are a crafting material in Enshrouded.
Goo is a crafting material in Enshrouded. (Crafting is enabled after a Bug Dust is crafted.)

facts.Quote: Used in a Smelter to melt ores and create alloys.

entities.d: Used in a Smelter to melt ores and create alloys.
entities.ob: The Crucible is obtained in the in Revelwood, as part of Crucible Needed For A Smelter for the Blacksmith.

facts.Quote: An assortment of fine instruments and tools to enhance the options of an Alchemist.

entities.d: An assortment of fine instruments and tools to enhance the options of an Alchemist.
entities.ob:
Crafting the Laboratory completes Scientific Instruments For A Laboratory for the Alchemist, after obtaining Scientific Instruments during the quest and crafting an Athanor.
Additional Laboratories can be crafted at the Alchemist after the quest.
entities.intro: Laboratory is a crafting station in Enshrouded, used to create advanced alchemical reagents.

entities.d: An Alchemy Station offering all needed tools to craft better alchemical products.
entities.ob:
Crafting the Alchemy Station completes A Black Cauldron For The Alchemist, after obtaining a Cauldron during the quest.
Additional Alchemy Stations can be crafted at the Alchemist after completing the quest.
entities.intro: Alchemy Station is a crafting station in Enshrouded.

entities.d: The best stories start small. For example with a stone.
entities.ob:
Stone is collected by picking up small stones on the ground throughout Embervale, including in the Shroud. Slightly larger stones can be mined with a Pickaxe.
It can also be mined from large rock formations in the Springlands and Revelwood.
entities.intro: Stone is a terrain material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: An item used by the Hunter to create better strings.
entities.ob:
The Hand Spindle is picked up at the in the Revelwood during The Hunter's Hand Spindle.
Additional Hand Spindles can be crafted at the Hunter after the quest, though the necessary ingredients are not available until reaching the Nomad Highlands.
entities.intro: Hand Spindle is a crafting station in Enshrouded, used to convert Flax into Linen.

facts.Quote: A metal Kettle which can be suspended over a Fireplace

entities.d: A metal Kettle which can be suspended over a Fireplace
entities.ob: The Kettle is obtained at the in , as part of Cooking Equipment For The Farmer for the Farmer.

entities.d: A sturdy material that was woven out of linen. It revolutionized the clothing industry due to its flexibility and durability. It looks better as well.
entities.intro: Fabric is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: After drying the Animal Fur on the Drying Rack, it becomes sturdier and more durable for a longer period of time.
entities.ob:
Dried Fur is crafted at the Drying Rack.
It is also a common physical item in the Kindlewastes.
entities.intro: Dried Fur is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A refreshing bottle of Water that grants more Stamina. Stay hydrated.
entities.intro: Water is a fluid in Enshrouded. It can be found in natural pools or generated by Water Dispensers. It can be stored in containers and crafting stations.

entities.d: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment.
entities.ob: Springlands Dirt can be found in the Springlands.
entities.intro: images= Springlands Dirt.png

entities.d: A rare and valuable metal thanks to its thermal conductivity. It's often used to create things that require a lot of heat.
entities.ob:
Copper Bars are crafted by the Smelter or by the Blast Furnace. The Blast Furnace smelts Copper Bars faster but requires Coal instead of Charcoal. The crafting recipe requires obtaining a Crucible during Crucible Needed For A Smelter to unlock.
It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world.
entities.intro: Copper Bars are a Revelwood Crafting Material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: The dusty remains of building materials.
entities.ob:
Obtained by mining with a pickaxe from ruined buildings.
Used in creating "Roughly Cut Stone Block"
entities.intro: Rubble is a terrain material in Enshrouded.

facts.Quote: A collection of tools - the heart of every smithy.

entities.d: A collection of tools - the heart of every smithy.
entities.ob:
Smithing Tools are obtained at the base of the small bridge at the north-western corner of in Umbra Hollow in the Nomad Highlands, as part of The Blacksmith's Request for the Blacksmith.
Note; upon grabbing the tools the quest will immediately advance to the last part of the quest to place the tools down at your base. This allows the player to skip the rest of the quest The Blacksmith's Request. Should they go for the tools directly.
entities.intro: images= Smithing Tools.png

facts.Quote: A centerpiece for the Alchemy Station.

entities.d: A centerpiece for the Alchemy Station.
entities.ob: The Cauldron is obtained from a Fell Monstrosity at in the Nomad Highlands, as part of A Black Cauldron For The Alchemist for the Alchemist.

entities.d: It's considered to be one of the most dangerous materials in the world! Touching it directly is usually not a good idea.
entities.intro: Poison Sack is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Mycelium of mushrooms that have been absorbing the magical properties of the Shroud. Could this be used for alchemical purposes?
entities.ob:
In the Shroud, mine ground to gain Mycelium.
fr:Mycélium (Matériaux)
entities.intro: Mycelium is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Possessing magical properties, bones of the dead are often used in alchemy.
entities.ob: Bones is a common drop from wildlife and Hollow, found throughout Embervale. It can also be mined from bone piles, such as in and around Hollow Halls, or picked up as a physical item in the world.
entities.intro: Bones is a Crafting Material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Useful for alchemical and magical purposes.
entities.intro: Bonemeal is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A protein rich ingredient created from crushed critter shells.
entities.intro: Bug Dust is a crafting material in Embervale.

entities.d: A traditional but mighty tool of communication. Used for the preservation of knowledge.
entities.intro: Paper is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A rare gem famous for its magical properties as a catalyst. It's great for channeling and shielding!
entities.ob: Mined from blue veins along the cliffs of the Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes.
entities.intro: Lapislazuli is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A feather of a bird or creature of some kind. Weighing next to nothing, it has to be useful for something.

entities.intro: Feather is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.ob: Scales are dropped by Dune Armadillos and Scorpions in the Kindlewastes. They are also collected from domesticated Dune Armadillos.
entities.intro: Scales are a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.intro: images= Fossilized Bone Dust.png

entities.d: Opens a lock
entities.intro: Lockpicks are an item to pick locks on doors to gain entry or Chests to access their inventories.

entities.d: A common ingredient with a smooth consistency. Needed for illumination of all sorts.
entities.ob:
Wax can be harvested from beehives, found on some trees throughout the world. There are a few near Longkeep, by the first tutorial base. The player can harvest the beehive without destroying the tree. The naturally spawning beehives do respawn.
Later in the game, after the Beehive Smoker has been found for the Farmer, the player can craft a Honey Beehive to craft Honey and Wax.
entities.intro: Wax is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A very durable and long-lasting source of light made from wax. Equip this before starting your expeditions into the unknown!
Anything can be domesticated with enough patience. Used to produce honey and wax.

entities.intro: Beehive is a crafting station in Enshrouded.

entities.d: The following sugar rush recharges stamina!

entities.intro: description= A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud.

entities.d: Glass broken into pieces offers many sharp edges used to enhance weapons.
entities.ob: Found as a physical item in the Kindlewastes.
entities.intro: Glass Shards is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A great source of protein that enhances the muscle mass. Best consumed before a good exercise.
entities.ob: Eggs are dropped by several creatures, primarily the Flightless Redtail, starting in the Nomad Highlands. They are also collected from domesticated Flightless Redtail.
entities.intro: Eggs is a consumable in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A simple meal, granting a lasting Melee Damage boost upon consumption. It tastes better in combination with other things, though.
Fleshy and tough. Better not eat it like this.
entities.intro: images= Raw Dune Armadillo Meat.png

entities.d: A specialty of the Kindlewastes - customers love it because of its health benefits!
entities.intro: The Grilled Dune Armadillo is a cooked Food item in Enshrouded. It can be cooked manually by the player at a Campfire or Fireplace. Alternatively, the cooking can be automated and queued at a Cooking Station. title= Grilled Dune Armadillo

entities.d: A staple in many traditional Revelwood dishes. It has a rejuvenating effect.
Roasted ribs were a delicacy back in the day, providing a substantial amount of health to the consumer.
entities.ob: Obtained from Raw Wolf Meat by manually cooking it at a fireplace, or by using a Cooking Station.
entities.intro: Grilled Wolf Meat is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Rich in protein and delicious, but only a small snack. Increases the Constitution of the user by a small margin.
This Glider is lighter and enables you to travel bigger distances.
entities.intro: Advanced Glider is a glider. It has greater speed and range than the Glider.

entities.d: This Glider will allow you to travel extraordinarily long distances.
entities.intro: title= Extraordinary Glider

entities.d: A formidable Glider which can cross even the deepest trenches, allowing you to rain death from above.
entities.intro: Ghost Glider is a glider. It has greater speed and range than the Extraordinary Glider.

entities.d: A slightly enhanced version of the Wooden Arrow, reinforced with small pieces of flint at the tip.
entities.ob: Flint Arrow is crafted by the Hunter. The crafting recipe requires obtaining Flintstone to unlock.
entities.intro: Flint Arrow is an Arrow shot from bows.

entities.d: When its luminous brood skipped over the waves near Pikemead's Reach, it was seen as a good omen. Unfortunately, no being, no matter how small, escapes the corrupting grasp of the Shroud.
entities.ob: Fell Wispwyvern Head is a drop from the Fell Wispwyvern encountered at in the Revelwood.
entities.intro: images= Fell Wispwyvern Head.png

entities.d: There's still a faint glow behind its eyes. Hopefully, they won't follow your every move.
entities.ob: Fell Sicklescythe Head is a drop from Fell Sicklescythes, encountered in the Kindlewastes Shroud.
entities.intro: images= Fell Sicklescythe Head.png

entities.d: A healthy protein rich snack. The color looks just perfect..
A healthy mix of vegetables. If handled with care, it won't only fill the stomach.
entities.ob: You'll unlock the Stir-Fried Vegetables recipe once you pick up Spice for the first time. images= Stir-Fried Vegetables.png
entities.intro: Stir-Fried Vegetables is a food crafted at the Farmer. It takes up the vegetable food slot.

entities.d: A red and juicy Tomato! If handled with care, it can have enhancing effects.
entities.ob:
Tomato is obtained from Tomato plants, found in the Springlands biome.
Each plant gives you x2 tomatoes.
Tomato plants can also be grown from Tomato Seedlings.
Abandoned villages or houses that has a garden
entities.intro: Tomato is a consumable in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A crisp, vibrant red bell pepper with a sweet, juicy flavor and a glossy skin.
entities.ob:
Bell Pepper is obtained from Bell Pepper plants, found in the Nomad Highlands biome.
Bell Peppers can also be grown from Bell Pepper Seedlings.
fr:Poivron
entities.intro: Bell Pepper is a consumable in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A very versatile crop that can be dried, grilled, or consumed raw, strengthening the consumer for a short duration.
entities.ob:
Corncob is obtained from Corn plants, found in the Springlands biome.
Each Corn plant gives you x3 corncobs.
Corncobs can also be grown from Corn Seedlings.
fr:Épi de maïs
entities.intro: Corncob is a consumable in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Roasted with a smoky aroma, it's a real pleasure for the taste buds, able to set free all of its strengthening attributes.
A nice snack for the way. The strength it takes to crack its shell, it gives back upon consumption.
entities.ob:
Hazelnut is harvested from Hazelnut bushes, found in the Revelwood biome.
Each bush yields multiple hazelnuts.
Hazelnut bushes can also be grown from Hazelnut Bush Seedlings.
entities.intro: Hazelnut is a consumable in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Watery and a little strange, this mushroom's odd taste comes from pure magic coursing throughout. Great power awaits the consumer.
A smoky grilled mushroom that temporarily amplifies your magical power when eaten.
entities.intro: The Grilled Penny Bun is a cooked Food item in Enshrouded. It can be cooked manually by the player at a Campfire or Fireplace. Alternatively, the cooking can be automated and queued at a Cooking Station.title=

entities.d: A bitter tasting herb that can be found in dry areas. It's said to have enlightening abilities.
entities.ob:
Sage Leaves is obtained from Sage plants, found in the Nomad Highlands biome.
Sage plants can also be grown from Sage Seedlings.
entities.intro: Sage Leaves is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: One has to be careful when harvesting this herb, but the reward is surely worth it.
entities.ob:
Stinging Nettle is obtained from Stinging Nettle plants, found in the Revelwood biome.
Stinging Nettle can also be grown from Nettle Seedlings.
entities.intro: images= Stinging Nettle.png

entities.d: A resilient herb, growing in the harsh Kindlewastes climate. Spiritualists were known to use it for mystical purposes.
entities.ob:
Grapple Plant is obtained from Grapple Plants, found in the Kindlewastes biome.
Large amounts can be found at and .
Grapple Plant can also be grown from Grapple Plant Seedlings.
entities.intro: Grapple Plant is a consumable in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A beautiful yellow flower with magical properties that increases the user's mana.
entities.ob:
Aureolin Flower is obtained from Aureolin Flowers, found in the Springlands biome.
Aureolin Flowers can also be grown from Aureolin Flower Seedlings.
fr:Fleur d'auréoline
entities.intro: images= Aureolin Flower.png

entities.d: Inedible, raw meat. Must be cooked over a campfire.
Raw Wolf meat. Must be cooked for proper consumption.
A sweet candy alternative made from plant fiber. The sugar rush is known to regenerate stamina for a short amount of time.
entities.ob:
Sugar Cane is obtained from Sugar Cane plants, found in the Nomad Highlands biome.
Sugar Cane plants can also be grown from Sugar Cane Seedlings.
entities.intro: Sugar Cane is a consumable in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Uncooked game. Must be roasted over a fire.
It's not properly cooked. Eating this raw would cause nausea.

Summons rescued survivors into your bases around a Flame Altar.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving the Blacksmith during Find The Sleeping Survivor. It is then crafted by Manual Crafting.

entities.d: This basic torch provides light for a short amount of time. Watch your step when exploring caves with this!
entities.ob: The recipe requires learning the names of Twigs and Plant Fiber. It is crafted by Manual Crafting.

entities.d: A Rake enhanced with scrap metal to increase its durability and speed. A decent tool to level hilly ground.
Hammer of the Ancients: An archaic building tool fueled by the Flame, capable of quickly erecting various structures around your home.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked by reaching the Return Beacon past the caves after exiting the Cinder Vault for the first time. It is then crafted by Manual Crafting.
entities.intro: title= Construction Hammer

entities.d: A block made from pale ribs and cranial bone. Its ivory guise decorates tombs and temples alike
entities.ob: Reading adds a hint into the Set List. This block is then obtained by looting the Bone Block in the northwest of the .

entities.d: A Bronze Block commonly utilized in art and science. It inspires greatness when used as a building material.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Bronze Bars for the first time. Bronze Bars can be crafted by combining Copper Bars and Tin Bars in the Smelter or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Ancient Spires.

entities.d: A washed version of the Rough Stone Block. Exposed to the weather, the stones have lost their rough feature over time.
entities.ob:
Reading adds a hint to the Set List. This block is then obtained by looting the Castle Wall Stone Block in the . It is found in a silver chest on a platform hanging over the Rift.
Finding this block is the objective of the quest Fortification.
entities.intro: title= Castle Wall Stone Block

entities.d: A neglected building material which is often used to building high and sturdy walls. This block protected the denizens of many cities before the fall
entities.ob: A hint is placed in the Set List after reading . This block is then obtained by looting the Citywall Block in . It is found in a silver chest on one of the scaffolds behind the tower guarded by the Scavenger Matron. Table Saw For The Carpenter leads to the same location, but the tower is further in.

entities.d: Copper adds a certain industrial warmth to your home with its characteristic color and shine.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring a Copper Bar for the first time. Copper Bars can be crafted by combining Charcoal and Copper Ore in the Smelter or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Ancient Spires. Copper Ore can be found all over Revelwood.

entities.d: Modeled after Kindlewastes city walls. This block is an accurate replica.
entities.ob: This block is obtained by looting the Desert City Wall Block in . It is found in a silver chest on the first floor of Emily Fray's tavern in the center of the Western district of town.

entities.d: A block of an ancient style, representing the architectural elements of the desert temples.
entities.ob: This block is obtained by looting the Desert Temple Block in the . It is found on a skeleton near the Flame Shrine.
entities.intro: title= Desert Temple Block

entities.d: A stone block often used for building sturdy soundproof walls.
entities.ob: This block is obtained by looting the Fancy Stone Block in . It is found in a silver chest inside the Keep.

entities.d: A block made of Fired Brick. It has a dull red color.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring a Fired Brick for the first time. Fired Bricks can be crafted by combining Lump of Clay and Wood Logs in the Kiln or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Ancient Spires. Lump of Clay can be found in Revelwood.

entities.d: Timbering is an ancient building technique that was very popular for its decorative effect.
entities.ob: After visiting and talking to the Cade Hawthorn with the "Building Diadwyn" option, a hint is added in the Set List. This block is then obtained by looting the Half-Timbered Block in . It is found in a silver chest in the middle of the town.
entities.intro: title= Half-Timbered Block

entities.d: A stone block refined with the highest level of craftsmanship, rarely seen even in ancient times.
entities.ob: This block is obtained by killing and looting the Scavenger Matron in , which is north-east of the Kindlewastes Ancient Spire.
entities.intro: title= Highly Polished Stone Block

entities.d: Iron Blocks are incredibly reliable and add decorative edge to any building.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Iron Bars for the first time. Iron Bars can be crafted by combining Iron Ore and Charcoal in the Smelter or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Kindlewastes Ancient Spire. Iron Ore can be found in certain mines and cave passages in the Kindlewastes.

entities.d: An aged stone that outlasted all else for centuries. Leaves one wondering what kind of things it might have seen.
entities.ob: This block is obtained by looting the Limestone Block in . It is found in a silver chest at the top of the old watchtower on the east side of town.

entities.d: A block crafted from Luminous Growth material that glows in the dark.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Luminous Growth for the first time. Luminous Growth can be commonly found inside cave passages.
entities.intro: title= Blue Luminescent Block

entities.d: A simple Metal Block. Despite the sleek design, it's quite uncommon as building material.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Metal Sheets for the first time. Metal Sheets can be crafted by combining Metal Scraps and Charcoal in the Forge or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Ancient Spires.

entities.d: A block of stone infested by Shroud spores.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Mycelium for the first time. Mycelium can be mined from fungal growths in Shrouded areas.
entities.intro: title= Mycelium Overgrown Block

entities.d: Perfect to build a provisional house in hot areas. Palm wood is a great alternative to conventional wood, mimicking its charm and durability.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Palm Wood Logs for the first time. Palm Wood Logs can be obtained by chopping palm trees in Kindlewastes or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Ancient Spires.

entities.d: A building material made from Sandstone, fitting the colors of the desert. It was created for architectural monuments.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Sandstone for the first time. Sandstone can be found in the Kindlewastes.
entities.intro: title= Refined Sandstone Block

entities.d: A Refined Stone Block, that plastered countless aristocratic buildings back in the day.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked after obtaining the Masonry Tools, an objective of Finding Masonry Tools.
entities.intro: title= Refined Stone Block

entities.d: Wood of extremely high quality that was manufactured with an eye for detail.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Wood Planks for the first time. Wood Planks can be crafted using Wood Logs with the Table Saw or found in the world.

entities.d: A Regular Sandstone Block. It's very cost - efficient.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Sandstone for the first time. Sandstone can be found in the Kindlewastes.
entities.intro: title= Regular Sandstone Block

entities.d: A Regular Stone Block used for everyday construction.
entities.ob: This block is obtained by looting the Regular Stone Block from the . It is found in a wooden chest on a platform on the side of the Bridge.
entities.intro: title= Regular Stone Block

entities.d: These rough stones shimmer slightly and have a very rustic style.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Flintstone for the first time. Flintstone is commonly found in the starting areas of the Springlands.
entities.intro: title= Rough Flintstone Block

entities.d: A rougher version of the Refined Sandstone Block, mainly produced for quantity. Due to its outer appearance it was mainly used for foundations.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Sandstone for the first time. Sandstone can be found in the Kindlewastes.
entities.intro: title= Rough Sandstone Block

entities.d: A Rough Stone Block built in the most basic manner of craftsmanship.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Stone for the first time. Stone is a basic material found throughout Embervale.

entities.d: A basic construction material. Not very pretty, but it gets the job done.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Wood Logs for the first time. Wood Logs can be obtained by chopping trees or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible wooden structures.

entities.d: A block made out of rocks extracted from the grounds. Roughly cut to the right size to stack them. Great for building a foundation!
entities.ob: Reading adds a hint to the Set List. This block is then obtained by looting the Roughly Cut Stone Block in . It is found in a large glowing crate on top of a ruined building in Netherton. The crate can be spotted from the nearby Ancient Obelisk.
entities.intro: title= Roughly Cut Stone Block

entities.d: A wood block made from trees that died a long time ago. They are extremely common in areas of the Shroud.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Shroud Wood for the first time. Shroud Wood can be obtained by chopping trees found in the Shroud.

entities.d: A Tarred Wood Block. Now only the shingles are missing.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Tar for the first time. Tar can be crafted by combining Wood Logs and Dirt in the Charcoal Kiln, obtained by cooking food for too long at a Campfire, or found in the world.

entities.d: In ancient times, these blocks were used to build dungeons and catacombs. Nowadays, they are in bad condition, but still serve their purpose.
entities.ob: A hint appears in the Set List after reading . This block is then obtained by looting the Weathered Stone Block in . It is found in a silver chest towards the end of the Catacomb, before the Fell Thunderbrute.
entities.intro: title= Weathered Stone Block

entities.d: Bathed in waterproofing liquids, this stone block is mostly used for Elixir Wells.
entities.ob: This block is obtained by looting the Well Block in a Kindlewastes . It is found in a silver chest near the Shroud Root, guarded by a Fell Monstrosity.

entities.d: Used to build thatched roofs. A basic and reliable solution to keep your head from getting wet.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Plant Fiber for the first time. Plant Fiber can be gathered from small shrubs.
entities.intro: title= Plant Fiber Roof Block

entities.d: A Roof Tiles Block needed to build shingle roofs, commonly see in construction.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring a Lump of Clay for the first time. title= Roof Tiles Block

entities.d: A natural way to decorate a roof.
entities.ob:
This block is obtained by looting the Stone Shingle Roof Block in . It is found in a silver chest in the tower of the church.
Finding this block is the objective of the quest A Destroyed Roof
Alternatively, this block is unlocked by acquiring Flintstone for the first time. Flintstone is commonly found in the starting areas of the Springlands.
entities.intro: title= Stone Shingle Roof Block

entities.d: Used to build thatched roofs. A basic and reliable solution to protect yourself from the elements
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Straw for the first time. Straw can be obtained by harvesting Wheat.

entities.d: Tarring the Wood Logs makes them more resistant and perfect for rooftops.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Tar for the first time. Tar can be crafted by combining Wood Logs and Dirt in the Charcoal Kiln, obtained by cooking food for too long at a Campfire, or found in the world.
entities.intro: title= Tarred Shingle Roof Block

entities.d: Made from straw and enhanced with tar. This is an enhanced version of the Plant Fiber Roof Block, especially good to protect from the elements
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Straw for the first time. Straw can be obtained by harvesting Wheat.

entities.d: Silvery like the sea glass on long-forgotten shores. Something within this ring inspires hope.
entities.intro: Mother's Eye is a ring. Its perks include two separate Lumberjack bonuses.

entities.d: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
entities.intro: Ring of Health is a ring. It increases both Health and Health Regeneration.

entities.d: A basic mining tool, made of the simplest of materials. It's not very durable or efficient, but does what it's supposed to do.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining Stone for the first time. It is then crafted by Manual Crafting.
entities.intro: Pickaxe is a basic Tool for mining.

entities.d: Forged from old metal rests, it shows signs of improvement in performance, but still does not deserve to be called a handy tool.
A decent tool forged out of copper. At least working does not become a hassle because of bad equipment.
A pickaxe made out of bronze. Only struggling with the hardest of stones, it can be considered very efficient.
A highly performant pickaxe made out of iron, useful in every environment. A truly handy tool to have.
This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.
entities.intro: Ring of Mana is a ring. It increases both Mana and Mana Regeneration.

entities.d: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.
entities.intro: Ring of Stamina is a ring. It increases both Stamina and Stamina Regeneration.

entities.d: A glimmering ring, plucked from the remains of someone who got more than they bargained for.
entities.intro: Ring of Rapacity is a ring. It increases Mana Regeneration but decreases Health and Mana.

entities.n: Sigil Ring of the Elder Guard
entities.d: "Captain Arkwright" is engraved in the metal. Given to the most loyal commanders.
entities.intro: title = Sigil Ring of the Elder Guard

entities.d: A delicate ring with the symbol of the Gemini — quivering with hatred in the moonlight.
entities.intro: Gemini Ring is a ring. Its perks include Health Leech and bonuses to dagger skills.

entities.d: A ring with glowing engravings that read: "May the Shroud never tear you down — Balthazar"
entities.intro: Alchemist's Ring is a ring. It increases Health, Health Regeneration, and Time In The Shroud.

entities.d: Filled with ancient magic, this ring provides light to you in dark places.
entities.intro: images = Ring of the Burning Light.png

entities.d: Filled with the burning Spark of the Flame, it's a valuable asset in the fight against the Shroud. It increases the time you can withstand the Shroud.
entities.intro: Ring of the Flame is a ring. It slightly increases the maximum time that may be spent in the Shroud.

entities.d: Created in the pursuit of immortality, it cost countless lives and promises more to follow.
entities.intro: title = Ring of Endless Life

entities.d: A simple and sturdy ring, decorated with three gemstones. The engraving reads: "To Cyrus, my most loyal Commander and friend". It was found inside the maw of the creature that haunts The Pike.
entities.intro: Commander's Ring is a ring. It increases Health, Mana, and Stamina.

entities.d: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
The fur is still speckled with bloody flecks.
entities.intro: title= Vukah Brawler Trophy

entities.d: The tusks remain dangerous since they don't dull after death. Never stumble!
entities.ob: Vukah Brawler Head is a drop from Vukah Brawlers, encountered starting in the Springlands.
entities.intro: Vukah Brawler Head is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Battle-hardened and brutish, the beastly Vukah would create their Brawlers through constant clashes. Only the strongest survived.
entities.intro: title= Bronze Vukah Brawler Trophy

entities.d: Every thundering roar is a spectacle, a bloody sight to behold. They've sunk their tusks into now-forgotten lands... Time to reclaim the kingdom.
entities.intro: title= Iron Vukah Brawler Trophy

entities.d: Mount it inside your halls to honor the Flame!
entities.intro: title= Fell Thunderbrute Trophy

entities.d: Its brain has been replaced by fungi and slush, but it's still tremendously heavy. The face is permanently petrified with a bitter expression.
entities.ob: Fell Thunderbrute Head is a drop from Fell Thunderbrutes, first encountered in the Springlands Shroud.
entities.intro: title= Fell Thunderbrute Head

entities.d: Even the most gruesome creatures must bend to the Flame, no matter their size. At least the slushing sounds inside its dome have subsided.
entities.intro: title= Bronze Fell Thunderbrute Trophy

entities.d: Cauterize the wound. Cleanse the spreading stain, and erase the festering blight. The light of the Flame cannot be denied.
entities.intro: title= Iron Fell Thunderbrute Trophy

entities.d: It reeks of foulness and rot, so best ventilate your halls properly.
entities.intro: title= Scavenger Matron Trophy

entities.d: There is still some vile liquid seeping from her lips.
entities.intro: title= Bronze Scavenger Matron Trophy

entities.d: Their queen has fallen. Elixir and blood taint the mud. A soothing silence finally veils the night.
entities.intro: title= Iron Scavenger Matron Trophy

entities.d: The change of tides was not kind to this creature. Perhaps it can finally rest.
entities.intro: title= Fell Wispwyvern Trophy

entities.d: The scales are heavy with muck and grime, dulling its glow. Hard to believe such a being once illuminated the water lilies under Pikemead's glorious rule.
entities.intro: title= Bronze Fell Wispwyvern Trophy

entities.d: Good omens fell to ash. Lights turned to lies, not promises. What was once a sign of good fortune has been snuffed out by a brush with fate. Pikemead's glory is restored.
entities.intro: title= Iron Fell Wispwyvern Trophy

entities.d: Inside, you can see nothingness. The absence of matter - of sanity and sanctum.
entities.intro: title= Fell Monstrosity Trophy

entities.d: Despair, hatred, loneliness... It grasps at anything to fill the void and leaves nothing but dust.
entities.ob: Fell Monstrosity Head is a drop from Fell Monstrosities, first encountered in the Nomad Highlands Shroud.
entities.intro: title= Fell Monstrosity Head

entities.d: Even when dead, the swirling chaos inside the gaping maw leaves people spellbound. Don't get too close.
entities.intro: title= Bronze Fell Monstrosity Trophy

entities.d: No longer does it reach for the sorrowful and the damned. The hunger in the dark was razed. Our dreams and minds are safe, for now.
entities.intro: title= Iron Fell Monstrosity Trophy

entities.d: Sometimes, the muscles around the eyes still twitch. It's natural, and not worrying. Mostly.
entities.intro: title= Fell Sicklescythe Trophy

entities.d: The Sicklescythe's tongue froze once struck down, too powerless to cast the final curse stuck in its throat.
entities.intro: title= Bronze Fell Sicklescythe Trophy

entities.d: Remains of a wandering specter, doomed to wither on the mortal plane. It's lips are sealed, its eyes are forever shut. The evil has been cast out.
entities.intro: title= Iron Fell Sicklescythe Trophy

entities.d: A scaffold that lets you reach higher points while building your base.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked by reaching level 5. It is then crafted at the Workbench.

entities.d: A scaffold that lets you reach higher points while building your base.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked by reaching level 5. It is then crafted at the Workbench.

entities.d: An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown. The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.
entities.intro: description= An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

entities.d: Opens all doors in "The Pike", castle within Pikemead's Reach.
entities.intro: Key to The Pike is a Key that opens locked doors in .

entities.d: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
entities.ob: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Saffron for the first time. Saffron can be found in the Kindlewastes.
entities.intro: Saffron Seedling grows into a plant that yields Saffron when harvested.

entities.d: An aromatic ingredient that calms the body, providing an instant boost of Stamina for the user.
A small amount of frozen or crystallized ectoplasm. It contains a tiny bit of life energy.
entities.ob:
Ectoplasm Fragments can be obtained from defeating Hollow enemies in the Hollow Halls.
Ectoplasm Fragments can also be obtained from green glowing bone piles in the Hollow Halls using the Pickaxe.
entities.intro: images= Ectoplasm Fragment.png

entities.d: A good amount of crystallized ectoplasm. Inside slumbers the essence of vitality.
entities.ob:
Ectoplasm Shards can be obtained from defeating Hollow enemies in Hollow Halls, it first appears in the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls.
fr:Éclat d'ectoplasme
entities.intro: images= Ectoplasm Shard.png

entities.d: A sizeable ectoplasm crystal. Its properties allow it to store life force for eons.
entities.ob: Ectoplasm Crystals can be obtained from defeating Hollow enemies in Kindlewastes Hollow Halls.
entities.intro: images= Ectoplasm Crystal.png

entities.d: A strange material extracted from ectoplasm fragments. It was filtered through cloth and coal but still smells odd.
entities.intro: Ectoplasm is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Unnerving goo. It bestows great powers on those who eat it.
entities.ob: Ectoplasm Soup is crafted by the Collector
entities.intro: images= Ectoplasm Soup.png

entities.d: A lotion that protects you from the cold seeping in. It grants its user +1 ice armor per level.
entities.ob:
Ice Protection Lotion is crafted by the Collector. The crafting recipe requires obtaining Ectoplasm to unlock.
It can also occasionally be looted from the Hollow Halls.
entities.intro: images= Ice Protection Lotion.png

entities.d: This material glows in a warm white light. It's an alchemical miracle!
entities.ob: White Glowing Substance can be crafted at the Alchemist
entities.intro: images= White Glowing Substance.png

entities.d: A building block crafted from Warm White Glowing Substance. Its radiance brightens up any space.
entities.ob:
This block is unlocked by acquiring White Glowing Substance for the first time.
White Glowing Substance can be crafted using Dirt, Mycelium, Bonemeal, and Wood Acid at the Alchemist.
entities.intro: title= White Luminescent Block

entities.d: The characteristic building material used inside the Hollow Halls. The originators of this architectural style are unknown and forgotten.
entities.ob: This block is obtained by looting the Hollow Halls Block in the . It is found in multiple silver chests in the rooms on the sides of the hall shortly before the Collector.

entities.d: Its only eye still aimlessly rolled around in its socket before the beheading. Eventually, though, it spilled out.
entities.intro: title= Hollow Cyclops Head

entities.d: This block made from polished red marble fragments has a mysterious, yet graceful look.
entities.ob: This block is obtained by looting the Red Marble Block in the . It is found in a silver chest in a room shortly before the Hollow Cyclops.

entities.d: An ominous, green glowing building block made from ectoplasm. The construction is reminiscent of stained glass windows.
entities.ob: This block is obtained by looting the Ectoplasm Block in the . It is found in a silver chest on top of a pillar in the middle of the large collapsed chamber.

entities.d: A special crafting station that allows its devious users to create otherworldly ingredients.
entities.intro: The Ectoplasm Press is a Collector Workshop. It refines Ectoplasm Fragment, Ectoplasm Shard, and Ectoplasm Crystal found in the Hollow Halls into Ectoplasm, Greater Ectoplasm, and Excellent Ectoplasm respectively.

entities.d: A green glowing material that's been cleansed to rid it of its toxic characteristics.
entities.ob: Purified Slime is created in the Ectoplasm Press.
entities.intro: images= Purified Slime.png

entities.d: Mined from the deadly waste found in the Hollow Halls. Caution is advised!
entities.ob: Toxic Slime can be obtained by mining the green deadly waste inside of Hollow Halls.
entities.intro: Toxic Slime is a crafting material in Embervale.

entities.d: This liquid was created by crushing ectoplasm shards and gathering the resulting goo. It's been filtered and is technically sterile.
entities.intro: Greater Ectoplasm is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A slimy broth made from crushed ectoplasm crystals. It's "safe to consume".
entities.intro: title = Excellent Ectoplasm

entities.d: Call upon the forces of the underworld to summon projectiles that seek out enemies.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining Ectoplasm Fragment for the first time. It is then crafted by the Collector.

entities.d: The frozen horns made from ectoplasm don't melt near the hearth fire. They must be magical!
entities.intro: title= Hollow Cyclops Trophy

entities.d: These bones are far larger than normal and are exceptionally sturdy.
entities.ob: Giant Bones are looted from Hollow Cyclops bosses found in the , , and . Each Hollow Cyclops drops 4-8 bones.
entities.intro: Giant Bones is a Revelwood Crafting Material in Enshrouded. It is the bone of a Hollow Cyclops.

entities.d: Opens doors in the Revelwood Hollow Halls.
entities.intro: images= Revelwood Bone Key.png

entities.d: Opens doors in the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls.
entities.intro: images= Nomad Highlands Bone Key.png

entities.d: Opens doors in the Kindlewastes Hollow Halls.
entities.intro: images= Kindlewastes Bone Key.png

entities.d: This slimy soup was improved with some salt, slow-cooked broth, and the added aroma of fearing death.
entities.ob: Greater Ectoplasm Soup is crafted by the Collector
entities.intro: images= Greater Ectoplasm Soup.png

entities.d: Even the most carefully cooked Ectoplasm Soup still tastes a little bit...fermented.
entities.ob: Excellent Ectoplasm Soup is crafted by the Collector
entities.intro: images= Excellent Ectoplasm Soup.png

entities.d: Crystallized from evaporated ectoplasm and bonemeal. Used to craft bone keys or decorative furniture.
entities.intro: Ectoplasm Gem is a crafting material in Embervale.

entities.d: When encased in solid bronze, the head looks even more menacing than before.
entities.intro: title= Bronze Hollow Cyclops Trophy

entities.d: New iron teeth now line its disturbing grin.
entities.intro: title= Iron Hollow Cyclops Trophy

entities.d: This simple fragment can be processed into a stunning Red Marble Block.
entities.ob: Can be found in the Hollow Halls
entities.intro: images= Red Marble Fragment.png

entities.d: A building block crafted from purified slime. It illuminates the room with a ghostly green glow.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Purified Slime for the first time. Purified Slime can be crafted by combining Charcoal, Salt, Toxic Slime, and Wood Acid in the Ectoplasm Press. Toxic Slime can be obtained by mining the green deadly waste inside of Hollow Halls.
entities.intro: title= Green Luminescent Block

entities.d: An extension to your backpack that increases your inventory by a lot.
entities.intro: The Large Backpack is a Backpack. It increases the default backpack size by 32 and does not stack with other Backpacks.

entities.d: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
entities.intro: title=Iron Adorned Round Door

entities.ob: This recipe is unlocked by crafting a Crude Mattress or by reaching level 5. It is then crafted at the Workbench.

entities.intro: title=Secret Red Marble Door

entities.d: A road material made from smooth stones. Traveling on it is a delight.
entities.ob: Can be easily obtained by digging out the dirt roads.
entities.intro: images= Smooth Stone Road Block.png

entities.d: A rugged-looking stone road material made from jagged rocks. Be careful where you step!
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by acquiring Stone for the first time.
entities.intro: images= Rocky Stone Road Block.png

entities.d: A new type of timber block for building. The brick accents warm up any space.
entities.ob:
This block is obtained by looting a silver chest found deep in the sewers beneath . The door to access the room with the chest must be picked in order to open.
One way to reach them is on the North East side of Fort Kelvin underneath a construction crane with a grapple point next to the ruins of a red brick building there is a stairway down.  Take the stairs down to arrive at a muddy sewer canal.  Follow the canal to the right and take the first left then continue forward to a set of rusted, locked bar doors on your left.  Go through the doors and down another set of stairs to a muddy room with a silver chest containing the blocks.
entities.intro: title= Brick-Timbered Block

entities.ob: Found in
entities.intro: title= Mixed Sandstone Block

entities.d: A building block made from tightly woven twigs. It's used inside Vukah buildings.
entities.ob: Found in Abandoned Vukah Village in the Blackmire

entities.d: Weathered stones, either built or claimed by the Vukah. The yellow-tinged moss in the furrows hints at its age.
entities.ob:
Found in
If entering from the very bottom near the Hidden Temple on the south side of the tree, navigate the initial trampoline section with the poison spitting flowers to arrive at a section of carved stone blocks and stairs.  Head left into the tree.  There is an encounter with an elite Vukah, a caster, and several spear throwers.  On your left is a torch near a descending set of spiral stairs. Go down the stairs to arrive at a stone door.  Inside is a silver chest across a tar pit with the Temple Stones building blocks.  If you encounter a small respawn point shrine before another vertical traversal section you've gone too far.

entities.d: A flute carved bone. You can use it to make music.
entities.intro: Flute is a Musical Instrument.

entities.d: A heavenly harp with silver strings, beloved by common folk and kings alike.
entities.intro: Harp is a Musical Instrument.

entities.d: Lutes are classic instrument of choice for bards. They can be used to play beautiful melodies with friends or alone.
entities.intro: Lute is a Musical Instrument.

entities.d: A sturdy material used in extravagant tailoring.
entities.intro: Reptile Leather is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Bark from the giant trees in the Blackmire. It feels rough but could look quite cozy.
entities.ob: Blackmire Bark is obtainable by digging Blackmire tree with a Pickaxe.
entities.intro: images= Blackmire Bark.png

entities.d: This century-old wood is found beyond the bark of the giant Blackmire trees.
entities.intro: images= Blackmire Heartwood.png

entities.d: A leafy green plant material naturally occuring in the Blackmire. It can be used for creating hedge mazes or garden artistry.
entities.intro: Foliage is a terrain material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: The flesh of giant mushrooms that grow in the Blackmire. It's a bit spongy, but otherwise solid enough for building.
entities.intro: images= Mushroom Flesh.png

entities.d: A complicated and interwoven nesting material, used for building extravagant tree houses.
entities.ob: Vukah Nesting Material is obtainable by digging Vukah houses with a Pickaxe.
entities.intro: images= Vukah Nesting Material.png

entities.d: A stone with multiple large ammonite imprints. There's a bewitching spiral shape on every side of it.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Springlands.
entities.intro: images= Ammonite Imprint.png

entities.d: An impressively big ammonite fossil. The remains of this marine cephalopod once housed a large, tentacled, sea-bound creature. In Embervale superstition, every identifiable rim extending from the spiral's core is said to bestow a day of good luck.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Springlands.

entities.d: This sea urchin sits atop a small platform and is too delicate to attempt removal.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Springlands.
entities.intro: images= Elevated Sea Urchin.png

entities.d: Globular and small, this sea urchin looks unassuming. A keen eye, however, will notice the fivefold symmetry.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Springlands.
entities.intro: images= Round Sea Urchin.png

entities.d: A strange cluster of sea urchins with varying sizes and shapes. Most of these were harmless ocean dwellers but some carried fatal venom, so it's best to avoid being stung.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Springlands.
entities.intro: images= Sea Urchin Cluster.png

entities.d: These two petrified gastropod shells have survived eons together. One can hope that their inhabitants kept each other company, but a solitary fate is more likely.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

entities.d: A lonely gastropod, sitting peacefully on a rock. Descendants of this variant still populated Embervale's shores until recently. Their colorful shells and slippery mucus were crushed into the iridescent pigment used to dye cloth.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Revelwood.
entities.intro: images= Single Gastropod.png

entities.d: A detailed trilobite imprint. The structure of its exoskeleton can still be made out clearly.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Revelwood.
entities.intro: images= Trilobite Imprint.png

entities.d: Multiple ancient trilobites, perfectly still and preserved in a petrified coat of sediment.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

entities.d: A cluster of dark crystals, growing together. They reach into different directions like the finger bones of the undead, clawing themselves out of their graves.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the .
entities.intro: images= Dark Crystal Cluster.png

entities.d: A large crystal with a threatening aura.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the .
entities.intro: images= Large Dark Crystal.png

entities.d: When gazing upon the crystal's surface, you feel the mirror image warp and shift into something... unsettling.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the .
entities.intro: images= Sparkling Dark Crystal.png

entities.d: A fossilized tooth that has dulled through the ages. While these fossils used to be plentiful, many are now forever buried underneath a dense layer of Shroud-infested water.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.
entities.intro: images= Dull Shark Tooth.png

entities.d: A large and slender sea lily, reaching up towards the surface and sky. If it had any sense of perception, it'd be able to judge the rise and fall of the sea, as well as the looming change in the waters.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.
entities.intro: images= Larger Sea Lily Fossil.png

entities.d: A sharp tooth from a large aquatic being, possibly a megalodon variant. It's preserved incredibly well and, surprisingly, might be comparatively recent. The owner must've had quite an appetite to need such gigantic teeth...
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.
entities.intro: images= Sharp Shark Tooth.png

entities.d: A robust, small sea lily fossil. No matter how you turn it, you're always greeted by a tendril or imprint.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.
entities.intro: images= Smaller Sea Lily Fossil.png

entities.d: An angular, golden urn. To match the sentimental value of the ashes, the grieving family adorned this vessel with ruby-red jewels. When shaking the urn, an act that is most likely godless and foul, you can hear clanking inside...
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the .
entities.intro: images= Bejeweled Golden Urn.png

entities.d: A golden urn with intricate ornaments in the shape of an eerie skull. The lateral detailing resembles fangs or claws.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the .
entities.intro: images= Foreboding Golden Urn.png

entities.d: This golden urn has multiple sigils inscribed on it. Their meaning far exceeds modern understanding, but scholars would presume these to be magical wards.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the .
entities.intro: images= Inscribed Golden Urn.png

entities.d: Nowadays it's rare to find crustaceans, petrified or alive. When crabs were still plentiful, they were caught for meat and later thrown back into the ocean as empty shells to appease the tides. This tradition didn't protect the waters from being corrupted by the Shroud, so it soon lost cultural relevance.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

entities.d: The fossilized remains of a lobe-finned fish. Descendents of this nocturnal drift-hunter were considered a delicacy and used to populate brooks and springs. However, consumption became impossible during the reign of the Shroud, as some fish developed new rows of rotting teeth and bit back.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

entities.d: The fossilized remains of a stranded prawn. Most of its tiny legs are not visible anymore, which is mournful for researchers but enjoyable for squeamish Flameborn.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

entities.d: Two leather straps, locked in place with enchanted ectoplasm crystals, seal away this tome's whispers. Despite being ancient, the fine aquamarine binding shows no signs of age or decay.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the .

entities.d: A mysterious old book that cannot be opened. No matter how hard you pull at the petrified covers, the tome doesn't seem willing to spill its secrets.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the .
entities.intro: images= Mysterious Tome.png

entities.d: This dusty old tome emanates a silent hate, restrained by thick iron shackles. Every fortnight, whenever this book is near, a spirited chain rattle fills the midnight air, and the pages inside convulse. It's as if something was trying to leap off the parchment to turn from ink to flesh and blood.
entities.ob: This collectible is found in the .
