entities.d: A white plant called "Calla Luna". To some, they represent purity and faithfulness, while they're a symbol of sensuality to others. However, everybody can agree on their beauty and that their nightly green glow sets them apart from other blossoms in the Nomad Highlands.
entities.ob:
Calla Luna are harvested from plants in the Nomad Highlands at night. The plant grows a bright green and is easily seen from afar.
fr:Calla Luna
entities.intro: Calla Luna is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Collected in the field for alchemical use. Also works as fishing bait, favored by uncommon fish. Can only be found at night in the fields of the Revelwood.
entities.ob: Can be found in the Revelwood at night.
entities.intro: Moth is a Fishing Bait in Enshrouded.

entities.d: "Glimmer Gentian" is a variant of the gentian plant that can only be found in the Albaneve Summits at night. It emits a bright pink glow and can be used to create vibrant color palettes.
entities.ob: Can be found in the Albaneve Summits at night, it grows a bright purple color and is easily seen from afar.
entities.intro: Glimmer Gentian is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A mushroom that is commonly found beneath the Shroud. It's inedible but can be processed into different materials in crafting.
entities.ob:
Shroud Mushrooms are obtained from chopping down mushroom stalks in the Revelwood Shroud.
Just like trees, larger stalks will drop more mushrooms.
Large stalks may drop as many as x8-12 Shroud Mushrooms.
entities.intro: Shroud Mushroom is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A pair of slippery Glands.
entities.ob: Critter Glands is dropped by flying Fell Critters, found in the Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes Shroud.
entities.intro: Critter Glands is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: If these brittle flakes are not handled carefully, they can fall apart and stick to everything, especially clothes.
entities.ob:
Brittle Shroud Flakes are obtained by chopping down mushroom stalks in the Kindlewastes Shroud. Just like trees, larger stalks will drop more mushrooms.
fr:Flocons de Brume fragiles
entities.intro: title = Brittle Shroud Flakes

entities.d: A carapace that protects the soft critter's flesh underneath.
entities.ob:
Critter Carapace is dropped by Fell Critters in Albaneve Summits or Veilwater Basin Shroud areas.
fr:Carapace de bestioles
entities.intro: Critter Carapace is a high-tier crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: The Shadowbloom is one of the few plants resistant to the Kindlewastes heat. Their bright orange glowing petals are only visible at night and are used to make vibrant colors.
entities.ob: Can be found at night in the Kindlewastes biome.
entities.intro: Shadowbloom is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A flower with star-shaped petals. It fills the moonlit valleys of the Albaneve Summits with the smell of death. Its deep, dark color can be used to make pitch-black pigments.
entities.ob: Found at night in the Albaneve Summits biome.
entities.intro: title = Stapelia Starflower

entities.d: Frozen, enshrouded liquid that's cold to the touch. It's unusable by itself, but can be processed into different materials in crafting.
entities.ob: Commonly found in the Shroud of the Albaneve Summits biome.
entities.intro: Enshrouded Ice is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Fine sand that's been infused with Shroud spores. Commonly found in the Kindlewastes biome.
entities.ob: Mined from glowing yellow patches of sand in the Kindlewastes Shroud.
entities.intro: Shroud Sand is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Acidic Mycelium mined in the Nomad Highlands.
entities.ob:
Mined from glowing green patches of ground in the Nomad Highlands Shroud.
fr:Mycélium acide
entities.intro: Acidic Mycelium is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Fresh Shroud spores, used to craft medicines that can cure the Shroud curse.
entities.ob: Collected from glowing blue mushrooms surrounded by groups of Fell, found at night throughout Embervale.
entities.intro: title = Fresh Shroud Spore

entities.d: Delicate petals tainted by the Shroud. Their surface is coated in a faint, toxic residue. Though fragile on their own, they are surprisingly resilient when woven into armor.
entities.ob:
Brittle Shroud Petals are dropped by Fell Vicious Vines, first found in the Revelwood Shroud.
fr:Pétales de Brume fragiles
entities.intro: title = Brittle Shroud Petals

entities.d: The faded heart of a Fell Foe. Its potent essence is key in crafting resilient armor and powerful healing spells.
entities.ob: Dropped by the Fell Sporehead, first found in the Kindlewastes Shroud.
entities.intro: Fell Heart is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A translucent, gelatinous substance. It shimmers with an eerie glow and possesses restorative and protective properties.
entities.ob: Can be obtained from Shroud Depthdwellers.
entities.intro: Shroud Gelatin is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Massive, hardened scales. Lightweight yet incredibly tough, they are prime materials for crafting durable and flexible armor.
entities.ob: Dropped by Fell Critter Queen, first found in the Revelwood biome.
entities.intro: title = Giant Critter Scales

entities.d: A jagged tusk that's been tainted by the Shroud. Pulsing with faint traces of toxic energy.
entities.ob: Corrupted Boar Tusk is dropped by Fell Boars, found in the Revelwood Shroud.
entities.intro: title = Corrupted Boar Tusk

entities.d: A volatile, acidic fluid harvested from weak Fell Foes. Its corrosive properties make it a valuable ingredient in crafting repair kits, where its unique chemistry is harnessed to restore the durability of worn-out items.
entities.ob:
Corrosive Blood is dropped by Fell ennemies, first found in the Nomad Highlands Shroud.
FR:Sang corrosif
entities.intro: Corrosive Blood is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Contains a higher Shroud concentration compared to spores.
entities.ob: Dropped by common Fell, starting in the Nomad Highlands biome.
entities.intro: Shroud Particles is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A thick, viscous substance harvested from Shroud Flayers. Its tenacious bonding properties make it essential for crafting armor and securely sticking materials together in various crafting recipes.
entities.ob: Dropped by Shroud Flayers, first found in the Nomad Highlands. Can be obtained from Shroud Flayer Seedling.
entities.intro: Shroud Adhesive is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Fine powder made from grinding critter carapaces.
entities.intro: Chitin Powder is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A dense, stone-like carapace torn from the Stalker, a ruthless assassin of the Shroud. Its near-unbreakable structure makes it a crucial material for forging tough and resilient armor.
entities.ob: Dropped by the Shroud Stalker, first found in the Nomad Highlands.
entities.intro: title = Petrified Shroud Stalker Shell

entities.d: A lightweight, protective gel. Has properties of Fell magic.
entities.ob:
Aerated Banshee Gel is dropped by Fell Banshees, first found in the Springlands Shroud.
fr:Gel de Banshee aéré
entities.intro: title = Aerated Banshee Gel

entities.d: A dense, swirling vapor extracted from Fell casters. It is imbued with ethereal Shroud magic, making it invaluable for crafting magical armor and powering devastating spells.
entities.ob: Dropped by Fell Sicklescythe, first found in the Kindlewastes. The quest Sun Temple Stories will take you to a , where one can be found.
entities.intro: title = Mist of a Fell Sicklescythe

entities.d: A potent base for crafting potions of various kinds.
entities.intro: Shroud Vapor is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A massive, razor-sharp talon.
entities.ob: Dropped by Fell Draconian Vulture, first found in the Kindlewastes biome.
entities.intro: title = Enshrouded Vulture Talon

entities.d: Large ribs of the most vile Fell Monster.
entities.ob: Dropped by Fell Monstrosity, first found in the Nomad Highlands biome.
entities.intro: Monstrous Ribs is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Highly concentrated Shroud energy, bundled in a pulsating core.
entities.ob: Crafted at the Alchemist. They also drop from the Fell Monstrosity and the Fell Sicklescythe.
entities.intro: Shroud Nexus is a crafting material in Enshrouded. They are also used to upgrade the level of a Flame Altar.

entities.d: A massive, unblinking eye brimming with Shroud power. Its overwhelming energy is a critical element in crafting exotic high-level armor.
entities.ob: Dropped by the Fell Cyclops, first found in the Albaneve Summits biome.
entities.intro: title = Enshrouded Cyclops Eye

entities.d: A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.
entities.ob:
Archaic Essence can be found by harvesting the yellow bulbs found in Springlands Shroud Lairs.
Bulbs may also be found in the Shroud Gazer tunnels found behind some Fell spawners.
entities.intro: Archaic Essence (5) is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Legendary runes are infused with an immense amount of magical energy. These rare and powerful artifacts are required to enhance legendary weapons, shields, armors and rings, unlocking their full potential.
entities.ob: Can be obtained by defeating powerful enemies, can also be crafted at the Blacksmith
entities.intro: Legendary Runes is a crafting material in Enshrouded. Legendary Runes are used to upgrade weapons to their maximum level enabling you to insert a gem into the weapon.

entities.d: An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by one row.
entities.ob:
The recipe is unlocked by obtaining Torn Cloth for the first time.

fr:Petit sac à dos (+8)

entities.d: Releases an aimed mending ray that continuously heals allies within.
An edible flower used to enhance the effect of certain dishes. It only blooms at night in the Springlands.
entities.ob: Midnight Lily is harvested from plants in the Springlands at night. The plant grows a bright blue and is easily seen from afar.
entities.intro: Midnight Lily is a consumable in Enshrouded.

entities.intro: Gloomberry is a consumable in Enshrouded.

entities.intro: images= Calla Luna Soup.png

entities.d: This wrap is a good alternative to the more commonly seen meat wrap. It still increases your health, and additionally, the shadowbloom stocks are very filling and extend your time in the Shroud.
entities.intro: A Night Plant, that boosts constitution and provides additional Shroud protection.

entities.d: This is an herbal tea with added glimmer gentian. The Blossoms create a smooth texture and extend your Time in the shroud.
entities.intro: images= Glimmer Gentian Tea.png

entities.d: A cluster of ectoplasm crystals. It holds immense magical powers inside.
entities.ob: They can be looted from Hollow in the Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls.
entities.intro: Ectoplasm Cluster is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.intro: The Dragons' Map is a crafting material in Enshrouded. This item is involved in the The Dragons' Last Breath quest.

entities.d: Repair your equipment on the go. Gradually restores a small amount of durability over time.
entities.ob: Crafted at the Hunter.
entities.intro: Repair Kit will repair up to 120 durability on your items.

entities.d: Once placed into Shroud-Infused farm soil, this seedling can grow into a Shroud Flayer.
entities.ob: Crafted at the Seedbed, also obtained from Shroud Flayer.
entities.intro: title = Shroud Flayer Seedling

entities.d: Shroud infused soil seems dangerous at first glance. However, when used in a controlled environment, it can create a potent bioactive environment that encourages rapid growth.
entities.ob: Crafted at the Farmer.
entities.intro: title = Shroud Infused Farm Soil

entities.d: A building block made from polished marble. It's as dark as the night sky.
entities.ob: This block is found in an unmarked tomb east of .
entities.intro: title= Midnight Tomb Block

entities.d: A building block made from polished marble. It's as dark as the night sky.
entities.ob: This block is found in a located near the in the Albaneve Summits.

entities.ob:
This block can be found in
. It is found in a silver chest on top of the tallest building on the North side of town.
entities.intro: title= Desert Shingle Roof Block

Removes Fell Curse upon use. Also applies a buff that prevents the curse from affecting the user for an hour.

entities.d: Removes Hemotoxin debuff upon use. Also applies a buff that prevents the hemotoxin from affecting the user for an hour.
entities.intro: Hemotoxin Antidote is a consumable item.

entities.intro: Bright Resolve is a color palette that can be used at the Coloring Station to dye your armor and clothing.

entities.intro: Gem of Agility is a weapon Gem that can be slotted into Weapons at Gem Forges using Archaic Essence.

Crafting the Mill completes Obtaining A Mill for the Alchemist, after obtaining Improved Millstone.
Additional Mills can be crafted at the Alchemist after the quest.
entities.intro: Mill is a crafting station in Enshrouded. The mill only works when there is a force generator nearby. You can use Small Water Wheel, Large Water Wheel or Small Windmill Sails to power the Mill.

entities.d: This aquamarine is as clear as a crystalline lake under bright blue skies.
entities.ob: fr:Aigue-marine
entities.intro: Aquamarine is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: The most tantalizing gold ore is often hidden beneath the water's surface, but be careful when spotting a glint of golden light at the bottom of a stream. The gold rush may swallow you if the waves don't.
entities.intro: images= Any Gold Source.png

entities.d: An underwater plant that only grows where the moonlight coats the sea floor. It has an enticing glow that spells demise for any diver willing to forget themselves in their pursuit of the light in the deep.
entities.ob: Gleam Root are harvested from plants in the Veilwater Basin, found only at night and predominantly located in the depths and on the shores of lakes and rivers in the region. The plant glows blue and is easily seen from afar, with the leaves resembling a tapered spiral.
entities.intro: Gleam Root is a crafting material in Enshrouded. The refined form, Gleam Root Dust, is a required material for the Flame

entities.d: Excessive experimentation proved that mixing slime and jelly creates sludge. All of these substances are entirely different and deserving of their own characterization due to their varied viscosity.
entities.intro: Shroud Sludge is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Vibrant and deeply disturbing if you allow it to invade your mind.
entities.intro: Shroud Slime is a crafting material in Enshrouded. Shroud Slime can be mined from the pink mycelium in the Veilwater Basin Shroud.

entities.d: A rose-colored piece of fresh mushroom meat. It has various applications.
entities.ob:
Pink Mushroom Meats are obtained from chopping down mushroom stalks in the Veilwater Basin Shroud.
Just like trees, larger stalks will drop more mushrooms.
Large stalks may drop as many as x8-12 Pink Mushroom Meats.
entities.intro: title = Pink Mushroom Meat

entities.d: The highest concentration of shroud energy, even higher than shroud nexus.
entities.ob: Crafted at the Alchemist.
entities.intro: Shroud Radiance is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Contains a higher concentration of Shroud compared to Shroud Particles.
entities.ob: Dropped by common Fell, starting in the Veilwater Basin biome.
entities.intro: Shroud Relic is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: The end product of chemical experiments, the crystals sparkle like shimmering sea foam.
entities.intro: title = Green Vitriol Dust

entities.d: A dark concoction distilled from enemy remains. It unveils the writings of their kin and sharpens your blade against them.
entities.intro: images= Drak Soulward Flask.png

entities.d: A delicacy of the marine world, it is crispy on the outside and soft and full of flavor on the inside. It is the perfect meal for weary adventurers.
A creamy curry made from plantain, rice, coconut milk, and vegetables. It's tart, earthy, and quite filling.
entities.intro: images= Plantain Curry.png

entities.d: This ginger tea tastes like the paragon of good health.
A cold smoothie made from coconuts and bananas. Best served with a little decorative umbrella, a cozy spot on the beach, and two swirly straws.
entities.intro: images= Coconana Smoothie.png

entities.d: Peppery, sweet, and packing a punch - this candied ginger is a great snack for anyone not afraid of strong flavours.
entities.intro: images= Candied Ginger.png

entities.d: The banana and honey combine to create smooth and creamy sweetness. A delicacy for any Flameborn with a sweet tooth!
entities.intro: images= Honey Baked Banana.png

entities.d: If pure, cooked rice is a bit too plain for you, then this fried rice might satisfy your needs. The added egg breaks up the granular texture of the rice, and the vegetables create a punch of flavor!
A local delicacy with a creamy texture and rich taste. It fills the belly and heals the soul, especially when the north winds are howling outside.
entities.intro: images= Creamy Mushroom Spaetzle.png

entities.d: An algae salad that tastes fresh and vaguely salty, like the sea. Something so green and natural must be healthy.
A scrumptious curry with lots of heat and depth of flavor. It will make you feel warm and cozy.
entities.intro: images= Taro Root Curry.png

entities.d: Fresh, healthy, fun to eat, and good for the soul. What more could you want for a meal?
The light sweetness of the coconut rice pairs well with the smoky fish filet. A shame you couldn't add a hint of lime or lemon!
entities.intro: images= Grilled Fish with Coconut Rice.png

entities.d: This creamy coconut milk makes for a great refreshment on a sunny day by the shore! It can also be used as an ingredient in cooking.
This cooked rice is delicious and vaguely aromatic. It will make for a good side dish.
A roasted shiitake mushroom. The new, smoky aftertaste brings out the umami flavor.
entities.intro: images= Roasted Shiitake Mushroom.png

entities.d: A ripe, yellow banana. It can be eaten raw or used in another dish — without the peel, of course.
These grilled algae buds can be sprinkled on your food to maximize flavor. They have added health benefits, too!
entities.intro: images= Grilled Algae Buds.png

facts.Source: Algae Plant Farm at growth level 4+

entities.d: These are the buds of an algae plant. They're inedible when raw, but can be dried.
These algae may look inconspicuous, but they are highly versatile.
entities.ob:
Algae is obtained from Algae plants found underwater in the Veilwater Basin biome.
Algae can also be grown from Algae Seedlings.

entities.d: Fresh ginger, perfect for brewing hot tea to keep any cold at bay.
Shiitake mushrooms work wonders for deepening the flavor of any dish.
entities.intro: images= Shiitake Mushroom.png

entities.d: A delicious root vegetable that must be cooked before its sweet and mild flavor can be enjoyed.
A hearty, creamy soup made with tender chunks of fish and fresh vegetables.
A creamy and delectable tomato soup, made more aromatic with a fish filet.
entities.intro: images= Tomato Fish Soup.png

entities.d: Fish cut into thick slices, be aware of the the bones, but you can still enjoy it.
The Filet of an epic fish, don't worry about any fish bones, they have been thoroughly removed.
This sleek, silver-scaled fish is known for the distinctive metallic sheen along its back, which gives it its name. It can be eaten raw, but will be even more beneficial when processed further.
entities.ob: Silverback can be obtained while fishing using Common Baits like Moth, and Common Fishing Bait.

entities.d: This bottom-dwelling fish is known for its long whiskers, which it uses to sense movement and food in the water. Apparently, it sensed your bait too. It can be eaten raw, but will be even more beneficial when processed further.
entities.ob: Whiskerfin can be obtained while fishing using Uncommon Baits like Moth, Grasshopper, and Uncommon Fishing Bait.

entities.d: A sleek fish with a vivid yellow fin, also known for its quick bursts of speed. It can be eaten raw, but will be even more beneficial when processed further.
entities.ob: Yellowfin can be obtained while fishing using Epic Baits like Frog, and Epic Fishing Bait.

entities.d: Hard to believe there is an even better concoction.
entities.intro: images= Ultimate Health Potion.png

entities.d: Instantly restores health massively, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.
entities.intro: images= Ultimate Health Potion.png

entities.d: An excellently formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.
entities.intro: images= Ultimate Mana Potion.png

entities.d: Instantly restores a large amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.
entities.intro: images= Ultimate Mana Potion.png

entities.d: The threatening teeth of a fish that is no threat anymore.
entities.intro: Fish Teeth is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Small fish bones that can be used in crafting. They feel brittle in your hands, but they'd be a terrible pain if stuck in your throat.
entities.intro: Fish Bones is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A gorgeous pearl. The magnetic pull of its lustrious shine is only enhanced by its rarity.
entities.ob: Draks have a low chance to drop. Otherwise they can be found underwater in clams.
entities.intro: Pearl is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Ground coffee beans, ready to be brewed into an energizing cup of coffee!
entities.intro: images= Ground Coffee Beans.png

entities.d: A handful of roasted coffee beans. They smell chocolaty and rich, with a light note of floral sweetness. They must be ground up before brewing.
entities.intro: images= Roasted Coffee Beans.png

entities.d: An electrified strand of nerves. It's a sought-after magical ingredient needed in some spell recipes.
entities.intro: images= Electric Nerve.png

entities.d: Take a moment to appreciate this fascinating flower and its beautiful pink color.
entities.ob: Passionflower are harvested from plants in the Veilwater Basin at night. The plant grows pink and is easily seen from afar.
entities.intro: Passionflower is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: An arrow that was touched by eternity. It's ice cold to the touch.
entities.ob: Eternal Frost Arrow II is crafted by the Hunter. The crafting recipe requires obtaining Enshrouded Cyclops Eye to unlock.
entities.intro: image= Eternal Frost Arrow II.png

entities.d: Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area.
entities.intro: title= Eternal Fireball II

entities.d: A resilient grasshopper that's adapted to the warm colors of the Nomad Highlands. It can be used as fishing bait, most likely to catch uncommon fish.
entities.ob: Can be found in the Nomad Highlands. Can be found at night.
entities.intro: Grasshopper is a Fishing Bait in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A golden jewel scarab beetle. It can be found in the Kindlewastes, and is used as fishing bait, especially useful to catch rare fish.
entities.ob: Can be found in the Kindlewastes, mostly night (includes dusk), on rocky patches of grass and rocky flat areas.
entities.intro: Scarab is a Fishing Bait in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A little pillbug, also called a roly-poly. It can be found in the Albaneve Summits and used as fishing bait, especially popular among rare fish.
entities.ob: Can be found in the Albaneve Summits. Can be found at night.
entities.intro: Pillbug is a Fishing Bait in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A tiny frog. He could be your best friend if you didn't need to use him as fish bait. Found in the Veilwater Basin and especially helpful to catch epic fish.
entities.ob: Can be found in the Veilwater Basin
entities.intro: Frog is a Fishing Bait in Enshrouded.

entities.d: An almost guaranteed catch for common fish!
entities.intro: title = Common Fishing Bait

entities.d: Any uncommon fish will want to take a bite of this bait.
entities.intro: title = Uncommon Fishing Bait

entities.d: This special mix drives rare fish wild and makes it easy for you to catch them.
entities.intro: Rare Fishing Bait is a Fishing Bait in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Catch regular epic fish with ease thanks to this special bait.
entities.intro: Epic Fishing Bait is a Fishing Bait in Enshrouded. Available at crafter after completion of Nice Day For Fishing.

entities.d: Very simple fishing bait made out of Critter Parts. Can be used to catch common fish, but not many will like the taste of that one.
entities.intro: title = Simple Fishing Bait

entities.d: A basic fishing rod made out of the simplest ingredients. Don't pull too hard, or it might break. It also doesn't lay particularly well in the hand, so long fights are not possible with it.
entities.ob: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining completing Unknown Waters and can then be crafted in the Manual Crafting menu.
entities.intro: Simple Fishing Rod is a basic Fishing Rod for used to catch fish and other items from bodies of water.

entities.d: A doomed fishing rod that is more likely to either catch valuables or junk. Well, one man's trash is another man's treasure!
entities.ob: The fishing rod is obtaining during A Cursed Catch and can then be crafted at the Hunter.
entities.intro: Cursed Fishing Rod is a Fishing Rod for used to catch fish and other items from bodies of water.

entities.d: This item will dispense water endlessly until it is submerged.
entities.intro: title=Natural Water Dispenser

entities.d: This item will dispense water endlessly until it is submerged.

A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.
entities.ob:
Archaic Essence can be found by harvesting the yellow bulbs found in Veilwater Basin Shroud Lairs.
Bulbs may also be found in the Shroud Gazer tunnels found behind some Fell spawners.
entities.intro: Archaic Essence (40) is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: This hide is sleek and water-resistant. It's commonly procured from amphibians that prefer wet or water-filled environments.
entities.ob: Water Reptile Hide is dropped from Water Reptiles in Veilwater Basin.
entities.intro: images= Water Reptile Hide.png

entities.d: A shiny material with an interesting texture. Any garment made with this will appear very fashionable.
entities.intro: images= Water Reptile Leather.png

entities.d: Vibrant palm leaves that offer ample shade in the blazing sun. They can be used as a crafting ingredient.
entities.ob:
Palm Leaves is obtained from chopping down palm trees in Veilwater Basin.
Can be obtained from fully grown Licuala Seedling.
entities.intro: Palm Leaves is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A dangerous, rotting substance, made half-liquid by its state of decay.
entities.ob: Can be obtained from Fell Vicious Vine in the Veilwater Basin
entities.intro: images= Cursed Shroud Sack.png

entities.d: A useful item for watering thirsty flowers and plants.
entities.intro: The Watering Can allows you to soak up and pour out water inside and outside of your build areas. It can soak up water from free-standing water pools or from Water Wells or Improved Water Wells. While its description implies a more central role in farming, it is not needed or useful for growing any Seedlings that do not require water cover, such as Rice Seedlings and Algae Seedlings.

entities.d: A tool that allows you to add and remove water in your base. It can also be utilized for irrigation and applying the Wet or Soaked Debuff to enemies. Fill it with water from a well or lake before beginning operation.
entities.intro: title= Portable Water Pump

entities.d: This steel pickaxe has been further refined through the addition of gold ornaments.
A steel axe, decorated with gold accents. It makes you feel much stronger, although the blade itself is most likely not improved by much.
A hand scraper and sieve that can be used to mine gold and other materials underwater.
These paper reed fibers can be used in many crafting recipes just like other plant fibers.
entities.ob: Paper Reed is gathered from reeds near water, or in bamboo forests.
entities.intro: Paper Reed is a Crafting Material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Gold coins, ideal for bedazzling, boasting, and bribing.
entities.ob: Gold Coins can be found in the Veilwater Basin, the Carpenter sends you on the quest Finding Gold Coins however, you can collect Gold Coins prior to that out in the world.
entities.intro: Gold Coins is an item in Enshrouded.

entities.d: The lakehopper is an agile fish that you might see "hopping" across the surface of a shallow lake - if you're lucky. It can be eaten raw, but will provide harmful effects to the player.
entities.ob: Lakehopper can be obtained while fishing using Common Baits like Fire Fly, and Simple Fishing Bait.

entities.d: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.
entities.ob: Veilwater Basin Rubble can be found in the Veilwater Basin.
entities.intro: images= Veilwater Basin Rubble.png

facts.Perks: Magic Shock Damage, Precise, Brutal, Magic Shock Damage, Precise

entities.d: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.
entities.intro: title=Guard Of The North Sword

facts.Perks: Health Leech, Cutting Damage, Renewal, Cutting Damage, Brutal

entities.d: The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.
entities.ob: Golden Recruit Axe can be found in a chest in Veilwater Basin.
entities.intro: image=Golden Recruit Axe.png

facts.Perks: Health Leech, Magic Fire Damage, Renewal, Magic Fire Damage, Cleansing

entities.d: Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.
entities.ob: Golden War Hero Axe can be found in a chest in Veilwater Basin.
entities.intro: image=Golden War Hero Axe.png

facts.Perks: Precise, Blunt Damage, Brutal, Sacred, All Blunt Damage

entities.d: You hear a faint whisper in the back of your head; unified in word, but spoken from a dozen tongues. A ghostly choir pleads with you. "Descending these dungeons is a fool's errand, can't you see? Turn back while you still can."
entities.intro: Fool's Errand is a Two-handed Sword.

entities.d: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.
entities.ob: Fertile Veilwater Basin Dirt can be found in Veilwater Basin.
entities.intro: images= Fertile Veilwater Basin Dirt.png

entities.d: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment.
entities.ob: Mined from the the ground in the Kindlewastes.
entities.intro: Fine Sand is a terrain material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A type of limestone derived from seashells.
entities.ob:
Shell Limestone can be found in Veilwater Basin.
FR:Calcaire de coquille
entities.intro: images= Shell Limestone.png

entities.d: This is a road material made from shell limestone, wich is commonly found in Vailwater Basin.
entities.ob: Can be easily obtained by digging out Shell Limestone roads.
entities.intro: images= Shell Limestone Road Block.png

entities.d: An organic growth that glows brightly in the deep, dark waters.
entities.ob: Underwater Luminous Growth can be found in Veilwater Basin.
entities.intro: images= Underwater Luminous Growth.png

entities.d: Soft, water-soaked mud, hauled up from the bottom of a lake or silent stream.
entities.ob: Underwater Mud can be found in Veilwater Basin.
entities.intro: images= Underwater Mud.png

entities.d: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment.
entities.ob: Veilwater Basin Dirt can be found in Veilwater Basin.
entities.intro: images= Veilwater Basin Dirt.png

entities.d: A bright, silvery white sand that mostly consists of crushed seashells.
entities.ob: Veilwater Basin Sand can be found in Veilwater Basin.
entities.intro: images= Veilwater Basin Sand.png

entities.d: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.
entities.intro: title= Underwater Overgrowth

entities.d: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.
entities.intro: Wisteria is an Overgrowth Material that can be placed down with the Overgrowth Tool on walls in your base.

entities.d: This plantain, not to be confused with a common banana, cannot be eaten raw. It's high in starch and can be used as a staple in many foods once cooked.
entities.intro: Plantain is obtained from chopping Banana trees in Veilwater Basin or harvested from a Banana Seedling.

entities.d: This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
A flask brewed from rare underwater materials, easing the strain of every powerful stroke.
entities.intro: images= Diver's Endurance Flask.png

entities.d: A generous portion of grilled meat. It must've come from a giant crab. Enjoy!
entities.intro: images= Grilled Crab Meat.png

entities.d: A sturdy grill, perfect for preparing advanced seafood dishes. With it, your food will come out extra crispy and full of flavor.
entities.ob: Complete the quest Seafood Grill For The Farmer.
entities.intro: Seafood Grill is a crafting station in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Grains of raw rice. They'll be very filling once cooked!
entities.ob: Can be harvested from Rice Seedling
entities.intro: Raw Rice is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff.
entities.intro: title= Eternal Ice Bolt II

entities.d: Releases continuous lightning strikes that can arc to multiple other close targets. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.
entities.intro: title= Eternal Arc Lightning I

entities.d: Roll out the red carpet whenever you wish, and make your entrance in style.
entities.ob: This block is unlocked by picking it up for the first time. It can be found behind a door requiring 4 switches to open on top of the eastern wall of .

entities.d: A seared fish cutlet that can only be prepared so well in a fish grilling cage. It is very flavourful.
entities.intro: images= Seared Fish Cutlet.png

entities.d: Seared on the grill to perfection, enjoy this exquisite piece of fish filet.
entities.intro: images= Seared Fish Filet.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Yellowfin.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Thornridge.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Shockfin.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Crimsonback.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Waveleaper.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Emberfin.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Silverback.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Whiskerfin.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Sunscale.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Stripetail.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Shimmerfin.png

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Lakehopper.png

entities.d: The Crimsonback, once a common Silverback that survived countless migrations, has scales that burn with a deep red hue. It is said to embody strength and endurance, and it is prized by seasoned anglers for its power and beauty. It can be eaten raw, but will be even more beneficial when processed further.
entities.ob: Crimsonback can be obtained while fishing using Rare Baits like Scarab, Pillbug and Rare Fishing Bait.

entities.d: You should only eat crab meat when it is grilled, as this is the best way to prepare it.
entities.ob: Crab Meat is dropped by Crabs and Drak.

entities.d: A freshly brewed cup of coffee. The flavor is strong, bold, and lightly acidic. What better way to start the day?
Coffee that's been refined with a splash of milk. The mild aroma makes it easy to sip!
A traditionally brewed cup of coffee with a hint of sugar. The sweetness pairs well with the depth of flavor.
These conserved banana chips do not regenerate as much health as the raw fruit. However, the duration of their effect lasts longer - and the crunch is nice too.
entities.intro: images= Dried Banana Chips.png

entities.d: A machine that's used to roast coffee beans. Necessary to make coffee.
entities.ob: The Coffee Drum Roaster is obtained during Coffee, The Greatest Good along with the Coffee Brewery.
entities.intro: images= Coffee Drum Roaster.png

entities.d: A handy machine that brews hot coffee. There is hope left in this world after all.
entities.ob: The Coffee Brewery is obtained during Coffee, The Greatest Good along with the Coffee Drum Roaster.
entities.intro: images= Coffee Brewery.png

entities.d: These raw coffee beans must be roasted and ground before unfolding the depths of their flavor!
entities.intro: Coffee Beans is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
entities.intro: title = Ultimate Ring of Health

entities.d: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.
entities.intro: title = Ultimate Ring of Stamina

entities.d: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.
entities.intro: title = Ultimate Ring of Mana

entities.d: A ring that radiates affluence and tragedy. Was it freed from the ivory finger of a friend, a brother, a child of fortune? Could its fealty have been betrayed, its blood promise broken? Whatever story this ring may tell, its former lords are long gone.
entities.intro: Ring of the Heir is a ring. It increases your Health Regeneration, Shroud Damage, Resistance and, time in the Shroud. As well as Frost Resistance in Albaneve Summits.

entities.d: Sometimes, when the tropical winds of the Veilwater Basin roll towards the cold air of the mountains, a thundersnow is born. The snowfall softens its roars, but it leaves traces in the freshly cracked surfaces of frozen ponds.
entities.intro: title = Ring of Thundersnow

entities.d: A grappling hook that can be used underwater.
entities.intro: title= Underwater Grappling Hook

entities.d: A stronger rod, which makes it easier to reel in a fish and you can also endure the fight longer.
entities.ob: The Improved Fishing Rod is crafted at the Hunter.
entities.intro: title= Improved Fishing Rod

entities.d: A fine fishing rod that makes catching as easy as possible. You can reel in fish faster and hold out longer if they put up a fight.
entities.ob: Can be crafted after starting Nice Day For Fishing from the Fisher.
entities.intro: title= Excellent Fishing Rod

entities.d: A lucky fishing rod that is quite strong and also more likely to catch treasures.
entities.ob: Can be found during Lucky Catch additional copies can be crafted at the Fisher.
entities.intro: Lucky Fishing Rod is a Fishing Rod for used to catch fish and other items from bodies of water.

entities.d: Despite wearing black bands over their eyes like bandits, they are relatively easy to catch
entities.ob: Shimmerfin can be obtained while fishing using Common Baits like Fire Fly, and Simple Fishing Bait.

entities.d: The Sunscale's name is derived from the distinctive shimmer of its scales, which catch the sunlight.
entities.ob: Sunscale can be obtained while fishing using Uncommon Baits like Moth, Grasshopper, and Uncommon Fishing Bait.

entities.d: A slender fish, recognizable by its distinctive black stripes running along its body.
entities.ob: Stripetail can be obtained while fishing using Uncommon Baits like Moth, Grasshopper, and Uncommon Fishing Bait.

entities.d: As its distinctive appearance suggests, the Thornridge,is an epic fish that only a very skilled fisher can catch.
entities.ob: Thornridge can be obtained while fishing using Epic Baits like Frog, and Epic Fishing Bait.

entities.d: Said to be born from lightning striking open water, the Shockfin is charged with electric energy. Be careful when trying to pull it out of the water.
entities.ob: Shockfin can be obtained while fishing using Epic Baits like Frog, and Epic Fishing Bait.

entities.d: This striking red fish is marked with black stripes. Its shimmering scales resemble cooling embers, earning it the name "Emberfin".
entities.ob: Emberfin can be obtained while fishing using Rare Baits like Scarab, Pillbug and Rare Fishing Bait.

entities.d: This is a rare, midnight-black variant of the Stripetail. Its dark scales absorb light, making it nearly invisible underwater. This patient predator strikes from the depths when you least expect it.
entities.ob: Shadowtail can be obtained while fishing using Rare Baits like Scarab, Pillbug and Rare Fishing Bait.

entities.d: The Waveleaper dances atop the waves with unmatched agility, a living embodiement of the waters untamed spirit.
entities.ob: Waveleaper can be obtained while fishing using Rare Baits like Scarab, Pillbug and Rare Fishing Bait.

entities.d: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
entities.intro: images= Grilled Shadowtail.png

entities.d: A soaked boot, damaged through years of water exposure. Perhaps the fur on it could be useful.
entities.ob: Can be obtained while fishing when you fail to reel in a fish.
entities.intro: Wet Boot is a crafting material in Enshrouded.

entities.d: A refined steel-tipped arrow embellished with gold. With this, you can fight in style.
entities.ob: Golden Steel Arrow is crafted by the Hunter. The crafting recipe requires obtaining Gold Bars to unlock.

entities.d: A plump leather container that's been filled with water. Throw it to make others Wet and Soaked! Wet Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 15 minutes. Warmth reduces the remaining duration. Soaked Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 30 seconds. Also reduces Ice and Shock Resistances by 30% but increases Fire Resistance by 30%. Soaked can be applied to enemies. Soaked duration can not be reduced by warmth, and transitions into the Wet debuff once it ends.
entities.intro: The Water Balloon allows you to throw water at others to apply the Wet and Soaked status effects. Throwing it at the ground or a player-built container allows you place water anywhere at an early stage, allowing you to build a lake or a water reservoir before you unlock other tools like the Watering Can.

entities.d: Once upon a time, Orpheus, a dark dragon, descended from the mountains to wreak havoc on the people's crops. While their names were forgotten, their fabled blades served as inspiration for many blacksmith apprentices.

entities.ob: This collectible is found at . Starting from the lowest entrance of the keep on the east side where the flame checkpoint is head south into the keep. Go to the left of the iron gate blocking the path, avoid traps, and lockpick the double door into the storage room. From here immediately head left and up two flights of stairs. Head straight through the door and you are on the other side of the metal gate. Turn around to face the way you came from storage and look up to see a balcony with another door. Climb up and lockpick the door to gain entry. Head through the room and go through the wall opening outside onto the scaffolding. Head left around the scaffolding and climb the metal grate. Head into the bedroom and go smash through the wooden barred door. The piece is on the balcony here.

entities.d: A relief that details the history of the Drak. Humanity is shown as victorious! They drive the attackers back, and the Drak are forced to retreat overseas to an archipelago.
entities.ob: This collectible is found at . It is located inside a bathroom on the north west end.
entities.intro: images= Drak Relief IV.png

entities.d: A relief that details the history of the Drak. The beasts stand victorious, their supremacy uncontested. They are locked in a constant fight for leadership, spilling blood in a desperate attempt to gain the Ancient's favor and become gods in the afterlife.
entities.ob: This collectible is found at . It is located behind one of the grates blocking in the Snapjaw. The gate opens after hitting the switch to release the water.
entities.intro: images= Drak Relief VII.png

entities.ob: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed when harvesting Coffee Beans for the first time, which can be found in Veilwater Basin.
entities.intro: images= Coffee Seedling.png

entities.d: A relief that details the history of the Drak. This piece shows the Drak arriving on Embervale. They spy Ancients buildings on the horizon, and are drawn to explore them.
entities.ob: This collectible is found at . It is located inside the temple. You will have to dive into the water Diving Helmet will be helpful. After diving in and passing the gold chest there will be a hole to swim further down. The relief is found in this room.
entities.intro: Drak Relief I is one of seven Drak Reliefs and can be placed in the Drak Relief Showcase.

entities.d: A relief that details the history of the Drak. The Drak are shown to build temples under a bright sun, resembling the Ancients. They see the Ancients as godlike due to their overwhelming prowess, and aim to gain their favor to ascend to godhood themselves.
entities.ob: This collectible is found at . It is located inside the temple, enter underwater from the east end. Upon entering avoid the arrow traps after surfacing and the dead-mans chest. You will have to dive into the water on the right side of the locked door, Diving Helmet will be helpful. After diving in pass the door switch and circle around. The relief will be located in a small room with Gold Coins.
entities.intro: images= Drak Relief II.png

entities.d: A relief that details the history of the Drak. This relief portrays two images. The top shows a human-made Night Sanctum, and people bringing books and scrolls as a tribute to the Ancients. The bottom sees the Drak enraged. They refuse to let humanity gain the favor of the Ancients, and attack.
entities.ob: This collectible is found at . It is located inside the temple. First you will have to gain entry by enabling the two switches in the side buildings next to the pool. Once opened Drak will flood out, defeat them and enter the temple under water, Diving Helmet will be helpful. Swim through on the left and avoid the spike traps. On the other side swim over some rubble into another room where the relief will be located.
entities.intro: images= Drak Relief III.png

entities.d: A relief that details the history of the Drak. The image encapsulates a moment of change: A shipwreck on faraway shores foretells humanity's demise. They see the Ancient Lands rise above the horizon — a sign of the gods turning away from humanity at last. For the Drak, the time to strike back has come.
entities.ob: This collectible is found at . It is located inside the temple. Descend down until the path splits at the lava and take the right. Following it around you will come to a grapple anchor, glide down south to the platform, then turn around and glide to the other side. Follow through the doorway and you'll see floor spikes on the other end of the hall is the relief.
entities.intro: Drak Relief V is one of seven Drak Reliefs and can be placed in the Drak Relief Showcase.

entities.d: A relief that details the history of the Drak. Flames swallow a town, and the sky is set alight. Chaos reigns as the Drak reappear in the Veilwater Basin. No defenders are visible.
entities.ob: This collectible is found at . It is located inside the temple. First you must open the inside door, the switch is in a crawlspace behind a pile of crates. Then you'll be directed through the underwater maze using a number of blue light switches that illuminate green lamps lighting the way. After doing a few switches you'll swim up to a large open room with open air and grating above, the room will have Gleam Root. On the west wall of this room in the water holds this relief.
entities.intro: images= Drak Relief VI.png

Sunny Loungewear Boots is a unique drop looted from an Ornate Chest in a locked house in the .
=== Walkthrough ===
• Starting Point: Beginning at the southern entrance to the , go to the second level of the mine.
• Finding the Chest: On the second level, you'll find a house with a light above its door. To the right there will be another house, though this one lacks any lighting, making it harder to spot. Once inside the house, use your hookshot to reach the loft of this second house, where you'll find a chest containing the boots.

entities.d: A miner's helmet with an attached light.
entities.intro: Miner Helmet is a Head Armor. It increases stamina regeneration and both stone and metal mining strength.

entities.d: A metal crown, coursing with electrifying energy. Wearing it makes the hair on your body stand up.
entities.intro: Circlet Of Lightning is a Head Armor. It can be found at

entities.d: Gauntlets that burn with pure, magical fire. Use them to set your foes aflame!
entities.ob: Flaming Gauntlets is found at Gateway Outpost "Endflame", lore note on the west side next to a repair station will guide you to find this item.
entities.intro: Flaming Gauntlets is a Arm Armor.

entities.d: A pair of boots that has been reinforced with Drak paraphernalia, granting you the upper hand in combat.
entities.intro: Drakian Boots is a Foot Armor. It increases your damage against Drak and, decreases the duration of the Wet debuff.

entities.d: A pair of gauntlets that are as cold as snow on a sunless eve. Use them to freeze the hearts of your enemies!
entities.ob: You'll find the lore note in a building in the center of on the second floor, that will guide you to find the Frozen Gauntlets located at the bottom of Lacemaker Pond from a corpse. You will need armor with Frost Resistance to reach the corpse.
entities.intro: Frozen Gauntlets is a Arm Armor.

entities.d: Heavy gauntlets that aim to protect your hands in combat. You can swing your blade fearlessly with these.
entities.ob: Greatsword Gauntlets is looted from a chest in the Inn, you'll find the lore note on the first floor and the chest containing the gauntlets at the top floor.
entities.intro: Greatsword Gauntlets is a Arm Armor.

entities.d: Inspired by the Quetzal, a magnificent bird that once graced the skies of Embervale, this beautiful armor set lets you feel the freedom and precision of flight when you wear it.
entities.intro: Quetzal Hunter Helmet is a Head Armor and part of the Quetzal Hunter Set. It decreases the duration of the Wet debuff.

entities.d: As Quetzals no longer roam Embervale, dyed palm laves are used in place of their feathers to recreate the look.
entities.intro: Quetzal Hunter Chest is a Upper Body Armor and part of the Quetzal Hunter Set. It decreases the duration of the Wet debuff.

entities.d: These gauntlets shield your arms as you chase through the undergrowth, striking foes from afar.
entities.intro: Quetzal Hunter Gloves is a Arm Armor and part of the Quetzal Hunter Set. It decreases the duration of the Wet debuff.

entities.d: They let you sprint through the thicket with the swiftness of wings.
entities.intro: Quetzal Hunter Pants is a Lower Body Armor and part of the Quetzal Hunter Set. It decreases the duration of the Wet debuff.

entities.d: In these shoes, you glide through the thicket effortlessly, barely breaking a sweat.
entities.intro: Quetzal Hunter Shoes is a Foot Armor and part of the Quetzal Hunter Set. It decreases the duration of the Wet debuff.

entities.d: A sporty headband with gold accents. It matches the set's belt and makes you feel like the ruler of the Summer Games!
entities.ob: Summer Games Headband is a unique drop that can be found in the Event Honor Hall.
entities.intro: Summer Games Headband is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Summer Games Set.

entities.d: An athletic-looking top made from vibrant fabric, held together by leather straps. The cropped cut lets you show off your physique!
entities.ob: Summer Games Cropped Top is a unique drop that can be found in the Event Honor Hall.
entities.intro: Summer Games Cropped Top is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Summer Games Set.

entities.d: Asymmetrical bangles that aid viewers in visually differentiating your arm movements as you dash past them towards the finish line.
entities.ob: Summer Games Bangles is a unique drop that can be found in the Event Honor Hall.
entities.intro: Summer Games Bangles is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Summer Games Set.

entities.d: The brown trousers possess a reinforced and padded knee area, visible through the applied scale pattern.
entities.ob: Summer Games Pants is a unique drop that can be found in the Event Honor Hall.
entities.intro: Summer Games Pants is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Summer Games Set.

entities.d: A bandage wrap that lets your takeoff foot achieve maximum jump power. These light coverings make it easier to protect your soles from harm as you prepare to propel yourself through the air!
entities.ob: Summer Games Boots is a unique drop that can be found in the Event Honor Hall.
entities.intro: Summer Games Boots is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Summer Games Set.

entities.d: Fashioned from a piece of fishing net and seaborn trinkets. It keeps the hair out of your face while you dive.
entities.ob: Siren Seeker Headband is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin (Buried underneath some rubble in the Little Lagoon).
entities.intro: Siren Seeker Headband is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Siren Seeker Set.

entities.d: Old fishing nets span across fabric, still carrying their spoils: Starfish, seashells, and strings of pearls are displayed proudly as accessories. Were they gifts from the mermaids and their folk, or simply lucky finds? It's hard to tell.
entities.ob: Siren Seeker Chest is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin (Underneath a sunken rowboat within Lake Heartblood
entities.intro: Siren Seeker Chest is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Siren Seeker Set.

entities.d: Small wonders hide amidst the seagrass of the shores, begging to be freed by nimble hands. What will you find betwixt the reeds today? A sharp edge made dull, a fallen star in the sand, a bottled siren's wish? The waves have a way of changing everything they claim, so be careful on your search!
entities.ob: Siren Seeker Gloves is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin (Right next to the Drak'Dal Temple by Starfish Shores).
entities.intro: Siren Seeker Gloves is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Siren Seeker Set.

entities.d: The cloth of these billowy pants falls in ripples like waves in the cerulean sea.
entities.ob: Siren Seeker Pants is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin (Behind the waterfall at the Cromville Hot Springs).
entities.intro: Siren Seeker Pants is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Siren Seeker Set.

entities.d: A pair of strappy sandals that make it easy to feel the sand and the sea.
entities.ob: Siren Seeker Boots is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin (Next to Driftwood Wake in the Dragondream Lake).
entities.intro: Siren Seeker Boots is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Siren Seeker Set.

entities.d: A striking, extravagant headpiece, just as broad as your magical abilities -- but you might get stuck in the doorway.
entities.intro: Tidecaller Headpiece is a Head Armor and part of the Tidecaller Set.

entities.d: A light tunic, as majestic in appearance as the powers it bestows when you spread your arms wide.
entities.intro: Tidecaller Tunic is a Upper Body Armor and part of the Tidecaller Set.

entities.d: They don't offer much protection, but enhance your magical abilities. The minimalist design also prevents you from getting sweaty hands.
entities.intro: Tidecaller Gloves is a Arm Armor and part of the Tidecaller Set.

entities.d: Those pants go perfectly with the tunic, creating a fluent transition. They allow enough air circulation to prevent overheating during battle.
entities.intro: Tidecaller Pants is a Leg Armor and part of the Tidecaller Set.

entities.d: Stride forth in these shoes, as swiftly as your mana regenerates.
entities.intro: Tidecaller Shoes is a Foot Armor and part of the Tidecaller Set.

entities.d: With this footwear, the healing power of the earth flows straight through you -- can you feel it?
entities.intro: Waveborne Ritualist Boots is a Foot Armor and part of the Waveborn Ritualist Set.

entities.d: With their simplicity, these pants bring balance to the outfit and allow the wearer's presence to shine.
entities.intro: Waveborne Ritualist Pants is a Lower Body Armor and part of the Waveborn Ritualist Set.

entities.d: Golden adornments define this set -- and naturally, the gloves are no exception.
entities.intro: Waveborne Ritualist Gloves is a Arm Armor and part of the Waveborn Ritualist Set.

entities.d: A magnificent aquamarine gleams upon this garment, said to amplify the wearer's healing abilities.
entities.intro: Waveborne Ritualist Tunic is a Upper Body Armor and part of the Waveborn Ritualist Set.

entities.d: The mask veils the face, but not the intent. You are here to keep one safe.
entities.intro: Waveborne Ritualist Helmet is a Head Armor and part of the Waveborn Ritualist Set.

entities.d: A sturdy pair of pants that will take you wherever your heart desires.
entities.intro: Wayfarer Pants is currently obtained randomly from Lootable Chests in the North-Western region of the Veilwater Basin. It is a singular item of clothing, not yet part of a set.

entities.d: Click-clack, click-clack - You hear the sound of her raised heel from a mile away, piercing the ground with unyielding staccato. As her steps quicken, so does your breath. Do not get caught in her path.
entities.ob: Blood Rose Boots is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin
entities.intro: Blood Rose Boots is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Blood Rose Set.

entities.d: Full metal armor with flourishing lines, swinging around the leg like ensnaring vines. Their thorns may prick, tear, and break her, but a wounded beer leaps highest, so they say.
entities.ob: Blood Rose Pants is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin
entities.intro: Blood Rose Pants is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Blood Rose Set.

entities.d: Sharp claws and a sharper tongue that refuses to be silenced - such is both sword and shield of the Blood Rose
entities.ob: Blood Rose Gloves is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin
entities.intro: Blood Rose Gloves is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Blood Rose Set.

entities.d: A laced-up metal bodice that births a crinoline-esque cage. You shan’t let these shackles fool you. No band, and no blood can manacle the wrath of the Blood Rose
entities.ob: Blood Rose Chestplate is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin
entities.intro: Blood Rose Chestplate is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Blood Rose Set.

entities.d: A chainmail coif, crowned with a wreath of roses and thorns. Beauty and pain, pleasure and despair - they all coalesce in her halo.
entities.ob: Blood Rose Mail Coif is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin
entities.intro: Blood Rose Mail Coif is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Blood Rose Set.

entities.d: A wearable floral wreath. Each sprig, bud, and leaf has been meticulously woven to create a blooming halo. Whoever hand-crafted this did so with botanical knowledge and love.
entities.intro: Efflorescent Hope Flower Crown is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Efflorescent Hope Set

entities.d: This royal chest piece frames a gleaming gem as its heart, reminding the wearer that hope will prevail. Taupe colored sleeves drape at the sides like a chrysalis being shed. The shoulders are accentuated by wing - or petal-like shapes, blossoming outwards.
entities.intro: Efflorescent Hope Chest is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Efflorescent Hope Set

entities.d: Gold veins flow through these gloves like sun-kissed rivers emerging after an icy slumber. The color of the underlying cloth changes from blue to green, symbolizing an awakening- a reach toward the light above the water’s surface.
entities.intro: Efflorescent Hope Gloves is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Efflorescent Hope Set

entities.d: Deep blue pants made from opaque material. With these, warmth will embrace you like a cocoon
entities.intro: Efflorescent Hope Pants is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Efflorescent Hope Set

entities.d: Cloven, finely segmented boots. Their shape is reminiscent of Faedeer hooves.
entities.intro: Efflorescent Hope Boots is a Cosmetic Armor and part of the Efflorescent Hope Set

entities.d: A pair of heavy-duty, gilded boots. Even sharp machinery pieces or rotating gears could not scrape them.
A dusty overcoat that reveals a metal exoskeleton beneath. A perfectly spherical cavity lies at the very centre of the chest plate, waiting to be adorned with an energy core.
Refined gloves that offer both protection and maneuverability for the fingers. Wearing them makes one feel as though they can work with utmost precision and concentration.
A helmet that hides the wearer's face below a sturdy sheet metal mask. The attached headpiece adds some height and heft, resembling the dawning sun. and the beginning of a new era of progress.
Comfortable cloth pants that protect one from scratches and burns. They feel well-insulated.
A hood and mask that shield the face below from smoke.
The reinforced soles allow the wearer to skulk through the overgrowth undisturbed, and to reach vantage points quickly. Perfect for an ambush!
These Cutthroat Gloves have been refined to be snug and effective.
The crest atop this helmet stretches upwards, caressing the skies like the crown of an Ancient Spire and willing to frame within it the light of the sun.
At first glance, these brown leather boots appear ordinary. A closer inspection reveals the cloven segment towards the front, which leaves "hoov"-like prints in the mud.
Two-toned leather gloves with light stitching. Their pattern gives them an almost whimsical feel.
A fanciful hood with expressive animal ears and a draping cape. It's made from layers of faintly dotted fur and is well-suited for walking among the Fae Deer as a trusted friend and companion.
A farmhand's overalls. The deep pockets are very helpful when gathering herbs or storing animal feed.
A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.
These glasses have seen countless horizons, failures, and successes. You think you can see some faint scratch marks on them. were they caused by vultures?
Loraine always liked to safekeep the bones she found on excavations personally, as they were too precious to entrust to anyone else.
Comfortable brown boots that make you feel as if you're being carried on a moth's wings.
Thick wooly gloves. They vaguely smell of bonfires and animal fur. Perhaps someone was wearing these while petting their furry companions by a fire?
A hood with a striking pair of plumose antennae. It keeps you warm and safe while wandering at night, and perhaps the antennae will help you find what you desire. or what you really need.
Furry boots wrapped with cords. The strands can be unwound to fasten makeshift bandages in a pinch. Decorative pom poms hang dangle from the sides.
This robe was fashioned to look like Emperor Moth wings. The double fur collar is especially soft. Below it lies a macrame shirt, expertly woven by nimble hands.
Tightly fitted boots, made from gold metal and cured leather. With these, you will be able to dance between the rain of bolts and blades, casting doom upon your foes with swift movements.
A lightweight, yet sturdy garnet-colored gambeson. The fire of magic burns inside. It is your duty, Flameborn, to tend to it evermore. for if you perish, the art of sorcery will die with you.
A pair of gloves that enable you to synchronise syllables to spells and weave warding sigils into bulwarks gracefully.

Magic frames everything you do. Whatever you witness, you see through the lens of the spark. a light that lingers just outside your vision, always peering in from the edges. You serve the Flame. Do so with elegance.

Lilly-white pants peek through from beneath the crimson coat. It makes you wonder: Can there be innocence in times of war? Despite the bloodshed, the hearts of those who wield magic must always remain pure. Otherwise, their power becomes unbound from both law and morals.
Gilded boots adorned with fiery, red gemstones. The pattern above the shins bears a resemblance to rays of sunlight or the glory of the blazing Flame.
A golden parade armor that shines brighter than the sun. A resilient flame flickers inside the chestplate's cavity, framed by the sigil which the Flameborn have claimed as their own.
Scarlet gloves that remind you of all the blood you've shed. Will the battle ever end? You do not know for sure, but today, we shall not dwell on it. for today is for the living.
A rising phoenix thrones above this helmet, protecting your steadfast gaze under its wings. It's a stern reminder of your destiny and the eternity it bears.
Comfortable pants fashioned from crimson cloth. Being both durable and imposing, they can be worn for parades as well as war.
These boots send tremors through the Hollow Halls wherever they step.
A weighty armor piece, adorned with diamond- and star-shaped studs in brushed gold. A crimson cape trails behind, withered like the wearer's spirit.
Heavy plated metal gloves, once worn by valiant soldiers.
A fan-like attachment juts from the helmet's vertex. From there, a red crown of straightened bristles radiates forth. forever imprisoning the wearer under its vermillion crescent.
Pants protected by manifold layers of metal plates. They were forged to hug the cylindrical shape of the leg and further show their creator's craftsmanship through the sparkling, golden rims.
A magnificent golden shell for your feet to slip into. With these, you can march with pride. down the streets of your kingdom, through the darkened forest, or into the heart of the Shroud.

It's a chestplate that has a short, red cape attached to the back. A Flame marks the centre of it, resting where the heart should be. Everything you do, and all you feel, is forever bound to the light of the fire. Let it fill you with pride and warmth.
Find the foe's weakness, then aim, breathe, and shoot. Nothing can escape your arrows when the Flame lights their path.
A hood and mask. The latter reminds you of a bird of prey, ready to descend on its enemies at high noon. Your shadow will be the last they'll ever see.
A pair of pants that fills you with a deep sense of duty despite their simplicity.
Vibrant plumes emerge from the crest of this helmet and meander forth like smoke. They remind one of the Mother Flame's light as it fades against the dusk.

entities.d: An assortment of dark layers that protect the wearer's legs from becoming singed, scorched, or incinerated when conjuring fire magic.
A robust circlet helmet that sits deep on the forehead and covers the eyes, like a descending one-eyed vulture.
Pants that anchor the wearer firmly on the ground through heavy fabric. While all others fall, you must remain standing... to pick them back up, to force them to continue on fighting.
Gloves with added metal rims that glisten like daggers in the dead of night.
A pair of pants that is fit to hide under midnight gloom.
Pale boots that have been adorned by multiple sets of heavy bangles, chaining the wearer to the molten grounds below the flying isles.
A pair of asymmetrical gloves. One leaves the fingertips bare, allowing you to check the direction of the wind.
Airy, slightly billowing pants that allow the wearer to feel the heat of the wind.
Heavy gloves, held together by pairs of belts and buckles. With these, you can grab whoever dares to threaten the Mother Flame straight by their wretched throat.
These are trousers that were created using superior ancient forging techniques. They bear the same mystical radial lines favoured by the ancient masters.
Tall boots that are held by leather straps on the inside, and carry a thick layer of additional sheeting towards the outside. They end in kneegards which press upwards further in a radial shape.
Imposing boots that leave a deep imprint wherever they step. They possess additional plating towards the outer sides, protecting the wearer from low blows.
Proud gloves forged from the finest celestium. Two metal ridges protrude from each spine, enabling the warrior wearing them to push their way through hordes of enemies if needed.
A pattern ripples across the fabric, creating subtle peaks and valleys as fingers draw across it.
Pointy-toed shoes that curl upwards ever so slightly near the front. They feel nice and cool on the feet.
Gilded gloves that brandish both royal blue and gold. They're emblazoned with long, metal claws that tip the gloves.
A voluptuous, pointed wizard hat! The crowning glory of clothing for the magically inclined.
Gray boots that have been darkened by smoke and ash.
Use these gloves to seal away your combatons' life force, binding them to life at your behest. Should they fall, nevertheless, then they will rise from the ashes with a flick of your wrist.
These boots allow you to step as if carried by the clouds, silently prowling between silvery shadows.
A mask that conceals the face, framing it with faintly printed cloth ribbons that fly in the wind. It may cover the eyes, but the devilish horns betray the wearer's aching for chaos nonetheless.
Solid metal and forged shut. No gap, no give.
His crown claws at him like reaching fingers. Much like the Mysterious Traveler, who needed no such grip to dig into his thoughts.
Overlapping scales of metal sheathe each finger. Flexible enough for a firm grip, heavy enough to crush.
Metal-clad from hip to heel, scales shifting with each step. unyielding to everything else.
A layered gambeson that's wrapped in chains and free-flowing silk. Its dark color scheme makes it easy to walk the path of ash and dust unseen.

A belted chest armor piece that's marked by thick, linear grooves and ridges that stretch towards the sun. It is adorned with violet trim that elevates the construction and creates a pleasing color palette reminiscent of the hues of the Mother Flame.
A venerated chestplate that reflects the light of the Mother Flame on its polished, angular surface. Anyone who brandishes this armor vows to be the sword of the Flame and the guard of the light.

An admiral blue-colored garment often worn by magic scholars who revere the Mother Flame. The cape attached to the shoulders falls in layers and ends in uneven trim, dancing like little spouts of fire as it moves in the wind.
A chestpiece made heavy through dangling chains. The metal plates leave an empty space, a void atop the heart, that's shaped like a keyhole. The once alabaster garments are ingrained with soot.
A royal blue gambeson that hides the wearer's blackened heart and devious intentions underneath. It allows you to blend into the night sky, providing the perfect camouflage for a downward strike.
Squint and you might see a heart etched into the plate. More heart than Vorgoth himself has shown in years. His real one drowned in Elixir.

Embervale is the world where Enshrouded takes place. It is a vast open world full of mutated creatures, mysteries and secrets to discover.
entities.body:
Embervale is the world where Enshrouded takes place. It is a vast open world full of mutated creatures, mysteries and secrets to discover.
The current seven regions of Embervale are the following:
The Springlands is a biome of relatively peaceful woods and meadows that acts as the starting region of Embervale. Its far eastern section is considered a distinct sub-biome, the Low Meadows.
It is home to Scavengers, Vukah, and weaker Fell enemies. Important resources like Salt and Flintstone can be found here. The Alchemist, Blacksmith, Carpenter, Collector, Farmer, and Hunter survivors are all found in the Springlands.

entities.intro: Balthazar is a survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. He is an accomplished alchemist and scholar found in the during Powerful Alchemy.
entities.body:
Balthazar is a survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. He is an accomplished alchemist and scholar found in the during Powerful Alchemy.
He crafts Potions and Spells, as well as Armor for caster-centric characters. His workstations include the Grinding Stones, Alchemy Station, and Laboratory to concoct ingredients for his craft.
Balthazar's quests seek to recover his lost Mortar and track down other tools like the Cauldron, Scientific Instruments or the Alchemist's Wall Hanging to construct workstations and expand his selection of recipes.
The Alchemist can craft a multitude of potions, spells, armor, and alchemical reagents.

entities.intro: Oswald Anders is the first survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. He is rescued from the the , not far from where you emerge from the , during Find The Sleeping Survivor. After his rescue, he will direct you to find other survivors.
entities.body:
Oswald Anders is the first survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. He is rescued from the the , not far from where you emerge from the , during Find The Sleeping Survivor. After his rescue, he will direct you to find other survivors.
Oswald crafts a variety of Armor, Weapons and Shields for melee-centric characters. He also crafts better Axes, Pickaxes and Rakes to help you obtain resources more efficiently, and a variety of Decorations. His workstations include the Charcoal Kiln, Forge, Smelter and Blast Furnace.
Oswald's quests seek to track down crafting equipment like a Crucible, Smithing Tools and a Bellows to craft new workstations and unlock new recipes. He asks you to find his daughter Rochelle Anders to act as a Blacksmith Assistant.
Oswald is the father of Rochelle Anders, and after a falling out with her, volunteered in 508 A.D. to be the first human to go into a vessel. He lived for at least some part of his life in Pikemead's Reach.

entities.intro: Cade Hawthorn is a survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. He is a skilled carpenter and mason, found in the during Carpentry Assistance.
entities.body:
Cade Hawthorn is a survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. He is a skilled carpenter and mason, found in the during Carpentry Assistance.
Cade crafts storage chests to manage your inventory, comfort items to help you get a better rest, and a wide variety of Decorations. He can also craft an Improved Grappling Hook and better Gliders to help you traverse Embervale more easily. His workstations include the Kiln and the Table Saw.
Cade's quests seek to track down crafting equipment like Circular Sawblades and Masonry Tools to craft new workstations and expand his selection of recipes. He asks you to find his Aunt Barelyn to act a Carpenter Assistant.
• Upon First Summoning — "Ohh, it’s good to be back! This place really fell apart without me, eh? Ha! Well, let’s spruce things up a bit!" — -

entities.intro: Athalan Skree is a survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. She is an experience hunter, tanner and weaver, found in the during Hunter Becomes The Hunted.
entities.body:
Athalan Skree is a survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. She is an experience hunter, tanner and weaver, found in the during Hunter Becomes The Hunted.
Athalan crafts Arrows and Armor/Ranged for bow or knive-centric characters. Her workstations include the Drying Rack, Hand Spindle, Tanning Station, Loom, Spinning Wheel and Spinning Machine.
Athalan's quests seek to track down her workstations. She also asks you to find the Farmer.
• Upon First Summoning — "The world of the living calls me once more. I’m a huntress – I can help you survive. Let’s not squander our time." — -

entities.intro: Emily Fray is a survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. She is a talented farmer and cook, found in the during Growing Stronger Together.
entities.body:
Emily Fray is a survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. She is a talented farmer and cook, found in the during Growing Stronger Together.
Emily crafts food, supplies for Farming and Animal Husbandry, and a variety of Decorations. Her workstations include the Seedbed, Cooking Station, Oven and Beehive.
Emily's quests seek to track down crafting equipment like the Kettle, Almanac of Plants and Seedlings, and Beehive Smoker to craft new workstations and unlock new recipes. She also asks you to tame animals.
See Farmer Quests for more quests.

entities.intro: Ancient Spires are teleportation structures constructed by the Ancients. The Alchemist theorizes that the Ancients constructed them as fast travel points. Only Ancients and Flameborn are able to enter the Ancient Spires.
entities.body:
Ancient Spires are teleportation structures constructed by the Ancients. The Alchemist theorizes that the Ancients constructed them as fast travel points. Only Ancients and Flameborn are able to enter the Ancient Spires.
• Each Ancient Spire features various climbing puzzles, locked doors, and traps that must be overcome to reach the top. Later Ancient Spires have challenges themed to the biome or sub-biome.
• Speak with The Flame at the top of each Ancient Spire to reveal the locations of Ancient Obelisks in the respective biome or sub-biome. Interact with the Ancient Obelisks to reveal the locations of Shroud Roots and Flame Shrines in the respective biome or sub-biome.
• Speaking with The Flame unlocks the Ancient Spire as a fast travel point on the map. Ancient Spires are usually located near the center of each biome and allows the surrounding area to be quickly traversed by Glider.
