entities.intro: "The Shroud is a ruinous fog that has corrupted nearly all of Embervale. Extended contact with the Shroud is deadly, even for you."
entities.body:
"The Shroud is a ruinous fog that has corrupted nearly all of Embervale. Extended contact with the Shroud is deadly, even for you."
"Your inner Flame protects you from the Shroud, but not indefinitely."
Entering Enshrouded areas (indicated by a white or red fog) starts a timer at the top of the screen. If it runs out, the shroud consumes you. There are various items that can allow you to survive for longer or shorter periods. Entering deadly shroud (indicated by a red coloration to the fog) will cause shroud time to deplete much quicker, and is not recommended. Various hazards can turn normal shroud into deadly shroud, such as the (explosive puffballs).
Various ways exist to restore shroud time. (respawn points) restore infinite shroud time by standing near them, and (those noisy canisters) will restore (amount of time). (potion name) restores (amount) of shroud time.

entities.intro: The Springlands is a biome of peaceful woods and meadows, and the starting region of Embervale. Its far eastern section is considered a distinct sub-biome, the Low Meadows.
entities.body:
The Springlands is a biome of peaceful woods and meadows, and the starting region of Embervale. Its far eastern section is considered a distinct sub-biome, the Low Meadows.
It is located in the south-west corner of the map, and connected to the Revelwood to the north and the Nomad Highlands to the east.
As the starting region of Embervale, the Springlands is populated by all the major enemy factions of Enshrouded. The area primarily features Fell, Scavengers, and wild creatures, but also serves as an introduction to the Hollow and the Vukah.
The first and most notable enemies in the Springlands are the Fell, a group of humans and wildlife corrupted by the Shroud. They are first encountered in the caves after exiting the Cinder Vault, and will thereafter be found in all areas within the Shroud. They are the game's primary antagonists and the main source of Shroud Spores and Torn Cloth.

entities.ob:
The Low Meadows are connected to the Springlands to the west, the Nomad Highlands to the east, and the Revelwood to the north.

entities.intro: The Low Meadows are a sub-biome of the Springlands located in the southwestern corner of the Embervale map.
entities.body:
The Low Meadows are a sub-biome of the Springlands located in the southwestern corner of the Embervale map.
The Low Meadows are connected to the Springlands to the west, the Nomad Highlands to the east, and the Revelwood to the north.

entities.intro: The Revelwood is a biome of dense forests and the location of the capital of Embervale, Pikemead's Reach. A small passage in the north-west leads to the Blackmire sub-biome, a murky swamp for levels 13-15.
entities.body:
The Revelwood is a biome of dense forests and the location of the capital of Embervale, Pikemead's Reach. A small passage in the north-west leads to the Blackmire sub-biome, a murky swamp for levels 13-15.
It is situated in the north-west corner of the map and connected to the Springlands to the south, the Nomad Highlands to the east, and Veilwater Basin to the north.
The Revelwood, while introducing no new enemy factions, presents a more hostile and challenging environment than the Springlands. Many of the factions have been upgrade with new and more dangerous enemy variants, and the Vukah become the primary enemy faction for the first time in the Blackmire region.
Scavengers are the first enemy faction encountered, having taken over the abandoned settlements in the south and west, including , , and . Be wary of a new Scavenger variant dual wielding Acid Cleavers patrolling these towns.

entities.intro: The Kindlewastes is a harsh desert biome and a region of Embervale. It is divided by the Shroud into two sections, a level 20-25 zone in the Northern Kindlewastes and a level 25-30 zone in the Southern Kindlewastes.
entities.body:
The Kindlewastes is a harsh desert biome and a region of Embervale. It is divided by the Shroud into two sections, a level 20-25 zone in the Northern Kindlewastes and a level 25-30 zone in the Southern Kindlewastes.
It is located in the eastern extremity of the map and connected to the Nomad Highlands to the west and the Albaneve Summits to the north.
The Kindlewastes' unique native wildlife include the hostile Draconian Vulture and Scorpion and the peaceful Dune Armadillo. A Fell variant of the Draconian Vulture can be seen in parts of the Shroud. Bats, Rats, and Spiders are also present.
Settlements in the Kindlewastes are largely inhabited by Scavengers or Fell. Vukah camps are also present in the north-east. There is a buried tomb near guarded by Hollow.

entities.intro: The Nomad Highlands is a biome of limestone bluffs high above the Shroud. Its major features include the Pillars of Creation, two massive volcanos connected to the Ancients, and Umber Hollow, a low region of dense Shroud in the center of the Highlands.
entities.body:
The Nomad Highlands is a biome of limestone bluffs high above the Shroud. Its major features include the Pillars of Creation, two massive volcanos connected to the Ancients, and Umber Hollow, a low region of dense Shroud in the center of the Highlands.
It is located in the center of the map and connected to the Springlands to the south-west, the Revelwood to the north-west, the Kindlewastes to the east, and the Albaneve Summits to the north.
Wildlife unique to the Nomad Highlands include the hostile Sabertooth Tiger and the peaceful Highlands Roadrunner. A hostile, Fell variant of the Mushroom Crab from the Revelwood can be found patrolling Shrouded areas of the Nomad Highlands. Bats, Rats, and Spiders are also present.
Settlements in the Nomad Highlands are largely inhabited by Scavengers, Vukah, or Fell. There are numerous Vukah camps and cave passages throughout the zone. Hollow can be found at a small graveyard in the north-west and the neighboring .

entities.intro: Alden Crowley is a survivor and Craftsperson, found at the end of the Springlands Hollow Halls during Explore The Hollow Halls.
entities.body:
Alden Crowley is a survivor and Craftsperson, found at the end of the Springlands Hollow Halls during Explore The Hollow Halls.
They practice dark magic and can create interesting necromantic items including Consumables and Decorations, as well as an Ectoplasm Press to turn ectoplasm crystals collected from the Hollow into edible soups. They delve into mystic arts like the Alchemist but with a darker theme.
The Collector also offers Quests to delve into the Hollow Halls and recover items.
• Upon First Summoning — "Ahh, fresh air fills my tired lungs… I greet thee, new friend. I am a ferryman. A keeper of souls, a guide in the night. How lucky for you, aimless one. I will light your path." — -

entities.intro: The Hollow Halls are ancient dungeon complexes of unknown origin, believed to have existed for several millennia. Shrouded in mystery, these vast subterranean crypts serve as banishment grounds for the Hollow — a cast-out underclass condemned by The Flame. Marked by a terrible curse, the Hollow are fated to walk Embervale in undeath for all eternity.
entities.body:
The Hollow Halls are ancient dungeon complexes of unknown origin, believed to have existed for several millennia. Shrouded in mystery, these vast subterranean crypts serve as banishment grounds for the Hollow — a cast-out underclass condemned by The Flame. Marked by a terrible curse, the Hollow are fated to walk Embervale in undeath for all eternity.
Among those consigned to the Hollow Halls are both humans and the formidable Cyclops — one-eyed giants who once dwelled upon the mountaintops of the Albaneve Summits. In an attempt to escape their fate, the Cyclops descended into the depths of the Halls, but still fell victim to The Flame's curse. Twisted by their torment, the Hollow Cyclops now haunt the lowest reaches of the Halls, serving as the final guardians and most formidable foes encountered within.
The Hollow Halls feature challenging content suggested for group play, although they can be completed solo by a well-geared character. They are designed to be more difficult than all but the hardest overworld encounters.
The standard encounter in each Hollow Halls is a large pack of Hollow enemies. Players should be prepared to fight multiple enemies at once, either by dealing area-of-effect damage or by eliminating the most threatening enemies (usually Hollow Reapers or Hollow Mages) first. entities.intro: Flame Shrines and Flame Sanctums are locations dedicated to worship of The Flame. You can find them scattered throughout Embervale.
entities.body:
Flame Shrines and Flame Sanctums are locations dedicated to worship of The Flame. You can find them scattered throughout Embervale.
Inside of these shrines is a Flame that when interacted with will give a Spark, these respawn and the amount obtained depends on the area you are currently in.

entities.intro: Mines are named locations in Embervale rich in mineral and ore deposits. Although resources can be harvested at locations other than named mines, each of the named mines holds particularly large deposits of specific resources and may be worth visiting when seeking to extract large quantities of those resources.

entities.intro: Valory is a survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. She is a well-travelled bard, found in the during Follow The Melody.
entities.body:
Valory is a survivor and Craftsperson that you rescue from an Ancient Vault. She is a well-travelled bard, found in the during Follow The Melody.
Valory is a longtime friend of Queen Jezmina. Her many stories from her travels of Embervale are vivid and the melodies she plays on her Lute just as sweet
She crafts Backpacks to increase inventory size, Musical Instruments that can temporarily buff your Comfort level.
She also crafts Cosmetic Armor, Wall Decorations to increase your Comfort, and Banners to beautify your home.

entities.intro: Albaneve Summits is a frozen mountainous biome added in the Souls Of The Frozen Frontier Update. It is dominated by Howling Peak - the highest point in Embervale - where a dangerous corrupted beast lurks.

Albaneve Summits is a frozen mountainous biome added in the Souls Of The Frozen Frontier Update. It is dominated by Howling Peak - the highest point in Embervale - where a dangerous corrupted beast lurks.
It is located in the northeast of the map and connected to the Nomad Highlands, the Kindlewastes to the south, the Veilwater Basin to the west, and the Cinder’s Cradle to the south.

entities.intro: Elio Ricci is a survivor and Craftsperson. He is rescued from the during Illuminate The Night.
entities.body:
Elio Ricci is a survivor and Craftsperson. He is rescued from the during Illuminate The Night.
Elio is a Barber who allows players to modify their character's appearance to better reflect their preferences without affecting any of the character’s stats or abilities. Rescuing Elio also unlocks the ability to use Dyes at the Coloring Station. His quests involve searching for new hair colors, eye colors, and Dyes.
The Barber was introduced in the Thralls Of Twilight Update. Players had frequently requested the ability to alter their character’s appearance, and the Barber was implemented as a way to fulfill this request.
The Barber allows players to modify various aspects of their character's appearance, including hairstyle, hair color, eye color, and skin tone. Initially, the customization options available are the same as those offered during character creation. However, additional hairstyles, hair colors, and eye colors can be unlocked through quests or obtained at Barbershops located in various towns.

entities.intro: Shroud Lairs are dungeons in the Shroud, treacherous winding dungeons filled with Fell creatures. Archaic Essence is found here, which is used to power Gem Forges to insert, upgrade, recycle and remove Gems from weapons.
entities.body:
Shroud Lairs are dungeons in the Shroud, treacherous winding dungeons filled with Fell creatures. Archaic Essence is found here, which is used to power Gem Forges to insert, upgrade, recycle and remove Gems from weapons.
You can find patches of Archaic Essence to mine inside the Shroud Lairs, along with bulbs to harvest. The Shroud Gazers also drop Archaic Essence.
The following weapons are unique loot that can only be found in Shroud Lairs.
• One-handed Club Crown Crusher

entities.intro: Night Sanctums are Ancient structures containing human knowledge. They have multiple traps that you must navigate to reach the end of the Night Sanctum.
entities.body:
Night Sanctums are Ancient structures containing human knowledge. They have multiple traps that you must navigate to reach the end of the Night Sanctum.
There are five Night Sanctums in each biome, one of which has a powerful Gem Forge that will upgrade your Gems higher than the forges you can find elsewhere.
• Contains the Scholar Of The Empyrean Boots.
• Contains the Scholar Of The Empyrean Cloak.

entities.intro: Veilwater Basin is a biome of tropical lakes and sandy beaches added in the Wake Of Water Update. Its lakes, formed by meltwater from the Albaneve Summits, are the largest remaining sources of surface water uncorrupted by the Shroud.
entities.body:
Veilwater Basin is a biome of tropical lakes and sandy beaches added in the Wake Of Water Update. Its lakes, formed by meltwater from the Albaneve Summits, are the largest remaining sources of surface water uncorrupted by the Shroud.
It is located in the center of the map between the Blackmire and the Albaneve Summits, is connected to the Revelwood to the south, the Albaneve Summits to the east, and the Cinder’s Cradle to the southeast.
The Veilwater Basin' unique native wildlife include the hostile Crabs and the peaceful Capybara.
The equipped bait determines the fish species, their relative selection weights and the non-fish loot pool. Fishing rods and spot modifiers can affect the frequency of wet boots and other loot.

entities.intro: Cinder's Cradle is a biome of lava filled mountains and sky islands added in the 1.0 Update.
entities.body:
Cinder's Cradle is a biome of lava filled mountains and sky islands added in the 1.0 Update.
It is located in the northern-most reaches of the map, bordering Albaneve Summits and Veilwater Basin.
Fish catch rates and available species depend on the specific fishing location within this biome rather than the bait used. Non-fish loot (trash and treasures) is determined by the equipped bait.
For full catch rate tables and trash loot pools, see Fishing Locations & Catch Rates.
